title: 美民主党大胜引发AI监管疑虑　科技股重挫、油价续跌
summary: （法新社香港5日电） 美国民主党在期中选举大胜，亚洲科技股今天卖压沉重，投资人重新评估人工智慧（AI）热潮的展望。民主党胜选部分原因，与美国各地资料中心快速兴建引发的民众不满情绪有关，油价则持续拉回。 发表时间： 05/11/2026 - 07:02 6 分钟 浏览时间 美国总统川普所属共和党遭遇历史性挫败后，整体市场多数走扬，油价则大幅下挫。共和党败选被归咎于高物价、关税及伊朗战争。 这次选举结果引发市场预期，川普可能寻求结束中东冲突，进而抑制通货膨胀，甚至软化贸易政策立场
content:
（法新社香港5日电） 美国民主党在期中选举大胜，亚洲科技股今天卖压沉重，投资人重新评估人工智慧（AI）热潮的展望。民主党胜选部分原因，与美国各地资料中心快速兴建引发的民众不满情绪有关，油价则持续拉回。

发表时间： 05/11/2026 - 07:02

6 分钟 浏览时间

美国总统川普所属共和党遭遇历史性挫败后，整体市场多数走扬，油价则大幅下挫。共和党败选被归咎于高物价、关税及伊朗战争。

这次选举结果引发市场预期，川普可能寻求结束中东冲突，进而抑制通货膨胀，甚至软化贸易政策立场。

然而，AI相关企业面临压力，市场担心原定资料中心建设计画可能受到影响，新上任的民主党国会议员可能加强监督。

在此之前，科技产业已受到投资人密切关注，包括大量资金投入新设施、研发及晶片开发，以及企业究竟何时才能实现获利等疑虑。

盛宝金融（Saxo Markets）分析师查纳纳（Charu Chanana）表示，这次选举加速了市场原本就已开始的AI产业重新评估。

查纳纳指出：「民主党掌控国会，将带来另一层不确定性，即监管审查。」她说，主要风险包括加强监管、资料中心受到限制，以及资本支出不确定性。

查纳纳表示，「国会的监督可能加速外界要求制定AI安全标准、进行独立模型评估，以及提高资料中心开发商的责任」，但「这并不代表政策将全面反对AI。AI对美国竞争力具有战略重要性，尤其是在与中国竞争方面，两党仍有相当大的共识，希望维持美国的领导地位」。

亚洲晶片股重挫，其中韩国SK海力士（SK hynix）股价下跌逾7%，三星电子（Samsung）下跌5.5%。

东京上市的铠侠（Kioxia）及爱德万测试（Advantest）股价下跌9%，东京威力科创（Tokyo Electron）跌幅超过7%，软银（SoftBank）下跌5%。

美国那斯达克指数期货下跌逾1%。

今年上半年AI热潮代表性市场之一的首尔股市下跌超过5%，台北股市下跌逾3%，东京股市跌幅也超过1.5%。

但香港及上海股市则大幅上涨，市场期待美中贸易紧张局势缓和，阿里巴巴、京东及腾讯等科技公司受到提振。

雪梨、新加坡、威灵顿及马尼拉股市同样上涨。

美国选举结果出炉后，油价重挫逾8%，两大原油基准价格均跌破每桶100美元，这是自10月初以来首见。市场乐观认为，川普将寻求达成协议，结束伊朗战争。这场持续冲突是推升通膨的重要因素之一，也重创美国消费者。

原油价格下跌缓解通膨疑虑，进而带动美国公债殖利率下降，今天殖利率再度走低。（编译：徐睿承）

content:
Fundraiser by Su Lee : Wipe Away Su Lee's Tears from her Composing Nights
Su Lee is organizing this fundraiser.
Dear friends, music lovers, and new music supporters,
It’s me, Su Lee, and I am currently working on my dissertation concert (for my Ph.D. in composition) which will be held on Sept. 9th 2019 Monday at 7:30pm in Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall at University at Buffalo.
The title of my dissertation composition and concert is Die Radikalen Tasten (The Radical Keys) in terms of aesthetics, Klang (sound), and theme.
I am writing a concerto for organ with keyboard ensemble, namely for our own tremendous Fisk Op.95 organ at UB. It will involve organ soloist with 1 assistant, 2 pianos (1 quarter-tone flat piano), 2 harpsichords (1 quarter-tone flat harpsichord), and 2 vibraphones which is a very rare instrumentation for microtonal new music.
The 1st half of the program features significant keyboard works from the 20th century such as Messiaen's solo organ work and Ives's quarter-tone piano pieces. As a special request from Dr. Fuller, who was in charge of the installation of the Fisk Op.95 organ at UB, I'm playing my very first organ transcription of Wagner's orchestral work.
The 2nd half of the program features my own 'radical' politically inspired compositions including a choral piece with organ accompaniment (dedicated to the UUCB Choir family) and my dissertation organ concerto. Both works are based on the Korean Democratic Uprising in May 1980 and the protest song written for the victims of the subsequent Gwangju massacre - a song that has became widely popular for activists and protesters, including those participating in the on-going Hong Kong protests.
Overall, it is a very colorful and unique combination and a rare program which is a you-don’t-want-to-miss concert.
I am modestly asking you for a little or big help in making my dissertation concert happen smoothly, especially given my financial struggles in not being able to even work legally for money off campus in America due to my visa status.
Your generous donation will be spent towards, (besides helping me wipe away all my tears and whining from composing numerous nights over the past few months and rehearsing in the upcoming days and nights):
Nine Musicians’ Performance Fee, about $3,000 – 3,300
Rent/Labor for Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall, about $1,000
Other concert related costs; buying performing materials, copying/binding score/parts, printing poster/program book, audio/video recording, photographing, tuning, reception, etc. about $1,200 – 1,500
Fortunately, I got awarded the MDRF (research fund) for $3,000 at UB so that I can be reimbursed afterwards, but I need money upfront now to pay first, and possibly more, to pay my dream team musicians fairly and to cover other costs.
Your genuine help means SO MUCH to me being an international Ph.D. student with many restrictions on earning money (3 months summer break without job, seriously!), as it will lighten my financial burdens and psychological anxiety when I absolutely need to focus more on my creative activities.
Simply speaking, you are contributing to a potentially "fabulous" new music piece, stimulating my further musical activities and making me believe that life (and the world) is so beautiful!
Every single one of your names will be acknowledged in my concert program book, and to thank you all, but not nearly enough, I like to give you in return as below:
$1~$49: a thank-you-card with a cover of a handwritten excerpt of my score
$50~$99: a thank-you-card like above AND a dvd of my dissertation concert (after my concert)
$100~$199: a thank-you-card AND a dvd like above, PLUS the autographed full score of my dissertation composition
$200~$299: EVERYTHING above AND one additional dvd of my Masters organ recitals (your choice of “Über den Namen B-A-C-H” or “Celebrating Lou Harrison’s 100th Birth-Year at Thunder Night”)
$300 or more: EVERYTHING above, PLUS a gift pack of Korean snacks/sweets/tea etc.
Please write me an email with your home address!
I am really excited to prepare my dissertation concert. Though I feel like this is sadly going to be my last self designed concert during my time in Buffalo (at UB), so I cannot wait to see many of you there!
Thank you so much for reading this and considering your donation.
I promise to pay you back with my "fabulous" new compositions and my performance, with the great help of my dream team of musician fellows!
Please feel free to spread the link to your social pages like Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter, or to emails, to help get the word out!
FYI, I am collecting your donations from now till October and GoFundMe takes 2.9% for transaction fee plus $0.30 PER Donation. Or you can donate by sending me a check to my place (email me for asking my address please!)

content:
黄之锋因勾结外国罪被判入狱 10 年；警察欢迎句|中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
黄之锋因勾结外国罪被判入狱 10 年；警察欢迎句子
香港众志前秘书黄之锋因勾结外国势力危害国家安全罪被判处十年徒刑。警察高级警司李桂华对重判表示欢迎，称黄是惯犯，并敦促他反思自己的行为
已不复存在的众志集团的一名前领导人在承认一项串谋外国或外部势力危害国家安全的罪名后，于 2026 年 11 月 5 日被判处 10 年监禁。该判决由高等法院作出。
香港警务处国家安全科高级警司李桂华对重刑表示欢迎，称这表明法庭已确定罪行的严重性。李说，黄自未成年时就参与社会活动，从18岁起就曾涉及各种犯罪行为，包括违反国家安全法。
李称黄是惯犯，并指出他过去的行为包括2019年6月抗议者包围警察总部的事件。李说，在那起案件中，黄被指控为组织者和煽动者。
警员表示，上述种种事件表明黄先生不愿遵守法律，甚至藐视法庭。李希望黄先生利用余下的狱中时间，继续反省自己对国家和香港的错误和伤害，培养对国家的尊重和正确认识。

Joshua Wong gets 10-year jail term for foreign collusion; police welcome sentence | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 5 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Joshua Wong gets 10-year jail term for foreign collusion; police welcome sentence
Joshua Wong, former secretary of Hong Kong's Demosistō, was sentenced to 10 years in prison for conspiring with foreign forces to endanger national security. Police senior superintendent Li Kwai-wah welcomed the heavy sentence, describing Wong as a repeat offender and urging him to reflect on his ac
A former leader of the defunct Demosistō group was sentenced to 10 years in prison on 5 November 2026 after pleading guilty to one count of conspiracy to collude with a foreign country or external forces to endanger national security. The sentence was handed down by the High Court.
Senior Superintendent Li Kwai-wah of the National Security Division of the Hong Kong Police Force welcomed the heavy penalty, saying it demonstrated that the court had determined the seriousness of the offence. Li said Wong had been involved in social activism since he was a minor and had been implicated in various offences from the age of 18, including violations of the national security law.
Li described Wong as a repeat offender, noting that among his past actions was the June 2019 incident in which protesters surrounded the Police Headquarters. In that case, Li said, Wong was charged as an organiser and an inciter.
The police officer said the various incidents showed that Wong was unwilling to abide by the law and had even disregarded the court. Li expressed hope that Wong would use the remainder of his time in prison to continue reflecting on the wrongdoings and harm he had caused to the nation and Hong Kong, and to cultivate a respect for the law and a proper understanding of the country.

summary: 香港政府招标租赁赤泉村道88号物业 |中国劳工布告栏 星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 香港政府招标租赁赤泉村道 88 号物业 香港政府已就赤泉村道 88 号政府物业的租赁招标。该场地仅限于零售、餐厅、展览或娱乐用途，不包括银行、场外投注点和汽车陈列室。香港特别行政区政府已发出招标
content:
香港政府招标租赁赤泉村道88号物业 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港政府招标租赁赤泉村道88号物业
香港政府已就赤泉村道88号的政府物业进行招标。该场地仅限于零售、餐厅、展览或娱乐用途，不包括银行、场外投注点和汽车陈列室。
根据 2026 年 11 月 5 日发布的政府新闻稿，香港特别行政区政府已就位于赤村赤村道 88 号的政府物业发出招标。
该物业只可作以下用途： (i) 零售商店及服务，不包括寺庙、出售或批发棺材的商店、仓库、酒店、电影院、住宅楼宇、办公室，以及《公众卫生及市政条例》（第 132 章）及其附属法例和修正案所界定的任何攻击性行业； (ii) 餐馆； (iii) 展览馆或会议厅； (iv) 娱乐或文化目的； (v) 上述用途的任意组合。该房产或其任何部分不得用作银行、场外投注处或汽车陈列室。
招标公告已于11月5日上载至政府产业署网站。投标文件可于星期一至星期五上午9:00至下午6:00（公众假期除外）到九龙油麻地海庭道11号西九龙政府合署9楼政府产业署索取，或从政府产业署网站下载。
有意竞投者如欲实地考察，须于11月16日或之前致电3842 6775与政府产业署预约。

Hong Kong government tenders lease of property at 88 Chek Chuen Village Road
The Hong Kong government has launched a tender for a lease of a government property at 88 Chek Chuen Village Road. The site is restricted to retail, restaurant, exhibition, or recreational uses, excluding banks, off-course betting branches, and car showrooms.
The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government has issued a tender for the lease of a government property located at 88 Chek Chuen Village Road, Chek Chuen, according to a government press release published on 5 November 2026.
The property may only be used for the following purposes: (i) retail shops and services, excluding temples, shops selling or wholesaling coffins, warehouses, hotels, cinemas, residential premises, offices, and any offensive trades defined under the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance (Chapter 132) and its subsidiary legislation and amendments; (ii) restaurants; (iii) exhibition or convention halls; (iv) recreational or cultural purposes; or (v) any combination of the above uses. The property or any part of it must not be used as a bank, an off-course betting branch, or a car showroom.
The tender notice was uploaded to the Government Property Agency website on 5 November. Tender documents can be obtained from the Government Property Agency at 9/F, West Kowloon Government Offices, 11 Hoi Ting Road, Yau Ma Tei, Kowloon, from Monday to Friday between 9:00 am and 6:00 pm (excluding public holidays), or downloaded from the agency's website.
Interested bidders who wish to conduct a site inspection must contact the Government Property Agency by calling 3842 6775 on or before 16 November to make an appointment.
Bids must be placed in the Government Logistics Department tender box at the ground floor of the North Point Government Offices, 333 Chatham Street, North Point, no later than 12:00 noon on 3 December. Late submissions will not be accepted.

香港官员称赞浙江大学论坛是科技联系的推动力中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港官员称赞浙江大学论坛促进科技联系
香港创新及科技局常任秘书长在浙江大学科技论坛上发表讲话，重点介绍了香港的五年计划、三个科技园、五个研发机构以及一项100亿港元的基金，以期在2030年建成全球创新中心。
创新科技及工业局常任秘书长周四在香港2026浙江大学科技创新论坛上致辞，称赞此次活动是杭州与香港科技合作的深化。
这位官员在致辞中表示，中央“十五五”规划将科技创新置于国家发展的核心位置，明确支持香港建设国际科技创新中心。他表示，香港政府9月公布第一个五年规划，将创新科技提升为引领香港高质量发展的核心战略高度，目标是到2030年建立扎根大湾区、辐射全国和世界的全球创新中心。
这位官员表示，香港正在加快三大创新科技园区和五个研究院的发展。他重点介绍了位于落马洲河套地区的港深创新园和位于北部都会区的新田科学城，它们将共同形成涵盖上游研究、中游试点和下游生产的完整产业生态系统。他表示，香港已拥有15个国家重点实验室和超过30个InnoHK研究中心，今年将设立100亿港元的创新及科技产业引导基金，支持科技企业。
本次论坛共有30个项目路演，60多个优秀项目，展示了浙江大学在人工智能和先进制造方面的优势。欢迎香港大学顶尖研究团队和优质企业利用香港的创新生态系统和“一国两制”下的独特优势，加速前沿技术走向全球。
他还对浙江大学香港校友会表示感谢，该校友会在香港拥有5000多名校友。该协会从组织社交聚会，到2023年成立人才委员会，再到如今举办论坛，帮助浙江大学项目落地香港。这位官员形容协会“聚则如火，散则星”，为香港发展注入宝贵动力。

Thursday, 5 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong official hails Zhejiang University forum as boost for tech ties
Hong Kong's innovation and technology bureau permanent secretary spoke at the Zhejiang University tech forum, highlighting the city's five-year plan, three tech parks, five R&D institutes, and a HK$10 billion fund to build a global innovation hub by 2030.
The Permanent Secretary of the Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau on Thursday addressed the Hong Kong 2026 Zhejiang University Science and Technology Innovation Forum, praising the event as a deepening of collaboration between Hangzhou and Hong Kong in science and technology.
In his speech, the official noted that the central government's 15th Five-Year Plan places science and technology innovation at the core of national development and explicitly supports Hong Kong in becoming an international innovation and technology centre. He said the Hong Kong government published its first five-year plan in September, elevating innovation and technology to a core strategic level to guide the city's high-quality development, with the goal of establishing a global innovation hub rooted in the Greater Bay Area and radiating across the nation and the world by 2030.
Hong Kong is accelerating the development of three major innovation and technology parks and five research institutes, the official said. He highlighted the Hong Kong-Shenzhen innovation park in the Lok Ma Chau loop and San Tin science city in the Northern Metropolis, which together will form a full industrial ecosystem covering upstream research, midstream piloting, and downstream production. He noted that Hong Kong already hosts 15 state key laboratories and over 30 InnoHK research centres, and will launch a HK$10 billion Innovation and Technology Industry Guidance Fund this year to support tech enterprises.
The forum featured 30 project roadshows and more than 60 outstanding projects, showcasing Zhejiang University's strengths in artificial intelligence and advanced manufacturing. The official welcomed the university's top research teams and high-quality enterprises to leverage Hong Kong's innovation ecosystem and its unique advantages under 'one country, two systems' to accelerate the global reach of cutting-edge technologies.
He also expressed gratitude to Zhejiang University's Hong Kong alumni association, which has over 5,000 alumni in the city. The association has evolved from organising social gatherings to setting up a talent committee in 2023 and now hosting the forum to help Zhejiang University projects land in Hong Kong. The official described the association as 'a fire when gathered, stars when scattered', injecting valuable momentum into Hong Kong's development.

content:
香港房屋局概述建设长者友善社区措施 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港房屋局概述建设长者友善社区措施
香港房屋局副局长概述了政府为创建长者友善公共屋村所做的努力，包括改造住宅、吸引长者友善企业，以及为长者居民试行跌倒检测技术。
香港房屋局副局长在 2026 年 11 月 5 日的立法会演辞中概述了政府为建设长者友善社区和加快在公共房屋中采用乐龄科技所做的努力。副署长回应立法会议员陈曾光的议案及另外三名立法会议员的修正案，详细介绍房屋委员会为长者创造共融宜居环境的措施。
住房管理局一直致力于通过吸引为老年人提供服务的企业来培育代际社区。现时约有330间商铺在长者人口较多的屋村提供康复及医疗用品、药房、诊所及社区服务中心等服务。该局的“幸福设计”指南包括两个专门针对老年人需求的概念：“就地养老”和“代际包容”。这些将被纳入新的公共住房项目，并在可行的情况下改造为现有的屋村。
此外，还在82个公共屋村设立流动服务站，提供中医、理疗服务。房屋署前线人员为独居、夫妻或其他长者居住的长者进行家居安全评估。符合资格的60岁或以上居民以及残疾人士可免费获得家居改造，包括坡道、加宽浴室门、扶手、水龙头以及更大的开关和门铃。房屋署每年进行约 5,800 次此类改造。
房委会亦正与多家供应商合作，试行智能乐龄计划，研究家居跌倒检测系统在公营房屋单位的应用。该试点涵盖安装条件、检测范围、隐私保护以及与现有应急支持服务的集成。另外，管理局正协助一家社会企业在公共房屋和居者有其屋计划屋村推出智能跌倒检测系统和服务试验。大约 200 个单身老人或家庭居住的单位已经安装了跌倒探测器，可以立即提供紧急援助。房委会计划扩大乐龄科技的应用，进一步提升长者住户的安全。

Thursday, 5 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Housing Bureau outlines measures to build age-friendly communities
Hong Kong Housing Bureau Deputy Director outlines government efforts to create age-friendly public housing estates, including retrofitting homes, attracting elder-friendly businesses, and piloting fall-detection technology for elderly residents.
Hong Kong's Housing Bureau Deputy Director, in a legislative address on 5 November 2026, outlined government efforts to build age-friendly communities and accelerate the adoption of gerontechnology in public housing. Responding to a motion by lawmaker Chen Tsang-kwong and amendments by three other legislators, the deputy director detailed initiatives by the Housing Authority to create inclusive, livable environments for elderly residents.
The Housing Authority has been working to foster intergenerational communities by attracting businesses catering to seniors. About 330 shops now provide services such as rehabilitation and medical supplies, pharmacies, clinics and community service centres in estates with high elderly populations. The bureau's 'Happiness Design' guidelines include two concepts specifically targeting elderly needs: 'ageing in place' and 'intergenerational inclusion'. These are being incorporated into new public housing projects and retrofitted into existing estates where practical.
In addition, mobile service stations offering traditional Chinese medicine and physiotherapy have been set up in 82 public housing estates. Frontline staff from the Housing Department conduct home-safety assessments for elderly residents living alone, with couples, or with other seniors. Eligible residents aged 60 or above, and those with disabilities, can receive free home modifications including ramps, widened bathroom doors, grab bars, lever taps, and larger switches and doorbells. The Housing Department carries out about 5,800 such modifications annually.
The Housing Authority is also piloting a smart-ageing scheme by working with multiple providers to study the application of home fall-detection systems in public housing units. The pilot covers installation conditions, detection range, privacy protection, and integration with existing emergency support services. Separately, the authority is helping a social enterprise roll out a smart fall-detection system and service trial in public housing and Home Ownership Scheme estates. About 200 units occupied by elderly singles or households have already received fall detectors, enabling immediate emergency assistance. The Housing Authority plans to expand the use of gerontechnology to further enhance safety for elderly residents.

content:
香港推出 6,900 万港元的老年护理科技补助金，计划 1,000 万港元的推广计划 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港推出 6,900 万港元的老年护理科技补助金，并计划 1,000 万港元的推广计划
香港创新局表示，超过 6900 万港元的拨款已用于老年护理技术。耗资 1000 万港元的“老龄化科技推广计划”将于 2027 年上半年推出，帮助企业将产品与现实环境相匹配。
香港创新科技及工业局 11 月 5 日表示，创新及科技基金已拨款超过 6900 万港元（880 万美元）用于老年护理技术项目。该局正在回应一项关于通过技术建设老年友好社区的立法动议。
创新科技及工业局副秘书长在立法会辩论中以粤语发言，概述政府根据国家“十五五”规划的策略，呼吁积极应对人口老龄化，并扩大“智慧老龄化”计划。该市的第一个五年计划推动产学研深度融合，加快包括养老技术在内的技术商业化。
科学园和数码港目前拥有约 140 家从事康复、认知辅助和辅助设备业务的公司。例如，由科学园公司和当地大学开发的用于慢性中风患者的人工智能康复机器人，目前已在中国大陆和香港的顶级医院使用。另一家公司创建了一个智能语音系统，可以提醒老年用户服药并确认活动出席情况。
物流与供应链多元技术研发中心开发的远程康复训练平台已在17个社区服务中心部署。政府还支持跨界别平台，例如乐龄科技博览及峰会，以及连接科技公司与社会福利组织的商业配对活动。
为了加速居家养老技术的应用，科学园正与香港房屋委员会合作开展“Live Smart Living Lab”项目。它将技术解决方案与现实世界的设置相匹配，并在设计过程的早期收集老年用户的反馈。此外，还计划设立新的“香港创新科技应用场景推广中心”，设有线上平台和实体中心，以满足需求与三个创新园和五个研究机构的解决方案。
今年的施政报告宣布了一项耗资 1,000 万港元（130 万美元）的“老龄科技推广计划”，帮助本地科技公司对接应用场景并完善产品。创新及科技基金正在筹备该计划，预计于2027年上半年推出。此外，数码政策办公室推行“聪明、明智、知识渊博”的数码共融计划，提供社区数码服务点和自学平台，帮助长者使用科技，改善生活质素。

Hong Kong unveils HK$69m in tech grants for elderly care, plans HK$10m promotion scheme | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 5 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong unveils HK$69m in tech grants for elderly care, plans HK$10m promotion scheme
Hong Kong's innovation bureau says over HK$69m in grants have gone to elderly-care tech. A HK$10m 'Ageing Tech Promotion Scheme' will launch in first half of 2027 to help firms match products with real-world settings.
Hong Kong's Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau said on 5 November that more than HK$69 million (US$8.8 million) from the Innovation and Technology Fund has been allocated to elderly-care technology projects. The bureau was responding to a legislative motion on building an age-friendly community through technology.
Deputy Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, speaking in Cantonese during the LegCo debate, outlined the government's strategy following the national 15th Five-Year Plan, which calls for active responses to population ageing and expanded 'smart ageing' initiatives. The city's own first five-year plan promotes deep integration of industry, academia and research to speed up commercialisation of technologies including those for senior care.
Science Park and Cyberport now host about 140 companies working on rehabilitation, cognitive aids and assistive devices. Examples include an AI-powered rehabilitation robot for chronic stroke patients, developed by a Science Park firm and a local university, which is now used in top-tier hospitals in mainland China and Hong Kong. Another firm has created a smart voice system that reminds elderly users to take medication and confirms activity attendance.
A remote rehabilitation training platform developed by the Logistics and Supply Chain MultiTech R&D Centre has been deployed in 17 community service centres. The government also supports cross-sector platforms such as the Gerontechnology Expo and Summit, and business-matching events that connect tech firms with social welfare organisations.
To accelerate the adoption of elderly-care technology in homes, Science Park is working with the Hong Kong Housing Authority on a 'Live Smart Living Lab' project. It matches tech solutions with real-world settings and collects feedback from elderly users early in the design process. A new 'Hong Kong Innovation and Technology Application Scenario Promotion Centre' is also planned, featuring an online platform and a physical hub to match demand with solutions from the three innovation parks and five research institutes.
This year's Policy Address announced a HK$10 million (US$1.3 million) 'Ageing Tech Promotion Scheme' to help local tech firms connect with application scenarios and refine their products. The Innovation and Technology Fund is preparing the scheme, expected to launch in the first half of 2027. Separately, the Digital Policy Office runs a 'Smart, Wise, Knowledgeable' digital inclusion programme that offers community digital service points and self-learning platforms to help seniors use technology and improve their quality of life.

国泰航空向香港员工发放一个月酌情花红 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
国泰航空向香港员工发放1个月酌情花红
国泰航空将向香港员工发放相当于2026年一个月工资的酌情花红，并于2027年1月7日发放。国泰航空列举了员工的奉献精神和公司成立80周年。当地管理层将分别宣布中国大陆和其他地区员工的安排。
国泰航空(0293)周四在内部信函中表示，将向2026年香港员工发放相当于一个月工资的酌情花红，计划于2027年1月7日发放。
该航空公司补充说，当地管理团队将另行公布中国大陆及其他地区符合条件的员工的详细安排。
国泰航空感谢员工持续的奉献、热情和团队合作。这是公司成立80周年的重要里程碑，公司表示很荣幸能够与同事们一起前进，继续追求成为客户最喜爱的服务品牌的愿景，共同建设航空公司更加美好的未来。
该航空公司此前曾于今年年初为符合条件的香港员工平均加薪3.5%。
国泰航空今年上半年盈利62亿港元，同比增长71%。截至2026年6月30日，国泰集团在全球拥有超过33,000名员工，其中约28,000名员工驻扎香港。

Cathay Pacific awards one-month discretionary bonus to Hong Kong staff | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 5 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Cathay Pacific awards one-month discretionary bonus to Hong Kong staff
Cathay Pacific will give Hong Kong-based employees a discretionary bonus equal to one month's pay for 2026, paid on 7 January 2027. The airline cited staff dedication and its 80th anniversary. Local management will announce separate arrangements for staff in mainland China and other regions.
Cathay Pacific Airways (0293) will award a discretionary bonus equal to one month's pay to its Hong Kong-based employees for 2026, with payout scheduled for 7 January 2027, the carrier said in an internal letter on Thursday.
The airline added that local management teams will separately announce detailed arrangements for eligible staff in mainland China and other regions.
Cathay Pacific thanked employees for their ongoing dedication, passion and teamwork. As it marks the important milestone of its 80th anniversary, it said it is proud to move forward alongside colleagues, continuing to pursue its vision of becoming customers' most-loved service brand and jointly building an even brighter future for the airline.
The carrier previously granted an average pay rise of 3.5 per cent for eligible Hong Kong employees at the beginning of this year.
Cathay Pacific reported a profit of HK$6.2 billion for the first half of this year, up 71 per cent year on year. As at 30 June 2026, Cathay Group employed over 33,000 staff worldwide, with about 28,000 based in Hong Kong.

summary: 台湾-美国专家：经济关系能否承受中期转变经济联系以承受中期转变：专家要激活文本转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。中新社台北11月5日电 台湾与美国日益增长的贸易和投资关系不太可能因国会加强对台美关系的审查而脱轨。一位台湾贸易专家周四表示，美国中期选举后的贸易协定。高级副执行董事兼副研究员李淳在台北举行的论坛后向记者表示
content:
台湾-美国经济关系能否承受中期转变：专家 - 聚焦台湾
台湾-美国经济关系能否承受中期转变：专家
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月5日电 台湾与美国日益增长的贸易和投资关系不太可能因国会加强对台美关系的审查而脱轨。一位台湾贸易专家周四表示，美国中期选举后的贸易协定。
中华经济研究院国际贸易政策中心高级副执行主任兼副研究员李淳在台北的一个论坛结束后对记者表示，无论台美贸易进展如何，供应链转移已经在深化经济一体化。贸易协定。
李说：“即使美国国会的监督时间更长，或者台湾的审查时间比预期更长，我也不认为这会影响台美之间正在进行的经济一体化。”
民主党在周二的选举中获得了众议院和参议院的多数席位。
当民主党一月份控制国会时，他们将结束共和党对参众两院和白宫两年的统一控制，加强国会对唐纳德·特朗普总统政府的监督，赋予民主党阻止立法的权力，并使参议院能够拒绝他的提名人。
民主党还夺取了共和党控制的佐治亚州、爱荷华州、内华达州、俄亥俄州和德克萨斯州的州长职位。
在德克萨斯州，吉娜·伊诺霍萨 (Gina Hinojosa) 击败了现任州长格雷格·阿博特 (Greg Abbott)，成为自 1990 年以来第一位民主党当选州长。她承诺，在州立法者通过保护当地社区的立法之前，将停止批准新的数据中心。
在国家政策研究所组织的论坛上，李表示国会将寻求更多地参与关税和技术政策。
他说，民主党可以挑战对包括台湾在内的美国盟友和伙伴征收关税，同时继续限制中国技术发展的两党努力。
在随后的采访中，李还淡化了州和地方对数据中心发展的限制对台湾硬件供应商的潜在影响。
他说，在台湾供应商提供服务器、电力系统和冷却设备之前，美国数据中心所有者和运营商必须解决许可要求和社区担忧。
李说：“短期内扩张可能会略有放缓，但总体方向没有改变。”他预计人工智能（AI）的需求将持续增长。
在论坛上，中央研究院政治研究所助理研究员傅泽民警告不要将民主党的胜利解读为广泛的意识形态转变。
“选民惩罚了特朗普，但这并不意味着他们对民主党产生了强烈的依恋，”傅说。
他将这一结果描述为“回顾性投票”，选民根据生活成本和家庭财务来评判政府。
他认为，关税和伊朗战争因其对价格的影响而成为国内关注的问题。
该研究所所长兼特聘研究员吴重礼也在论坛上发表讲话，他警告说，当地政治限制可能会影响台湾在美国人工智能相关的投资。

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan-U.S. economic ties to withstand midterm shifts: Expert - Focus Taiwan
Taiwan-U.S. economic ties to withstand midterm shifts: Expert
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 5 (CNA) Taiwan's growing trade and investment ties with the United States are unlikely to be derailed by increased congressional scrutiny of Taiwan-U.S. trade agreements following the U.S. midterm elections, a Taiwanese trade expert said Thursday.
Speaking to reporters after a forum in Taipei, Roy Lee (李淳), a senior deputy executive director and associate research fellow at the Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research's Center for International Trade Policy, said supply-chain shifts were already deepening economic integration regardless of progress on the Taiwan-U.S. trade agreement.
"Even if congressional oversight in the U.S. takes longer, or Taiwan's review takes longer than expected, I don't think that will affect the ongoing economic integration between Taiwan and the U.S.," Lee said.
Democrats secured majorities in both the House of Representatives and Senate in Tuesday's elections.
When Democrats take control of Congress in January, they will end two years of unified Republican control of both chambers and the White House, strengthening congressional oversight of President Donald Trump's administration, giving Democrats power to block legislation and enabling the Senate to reject his nominees.
Democrats also captured Republican-held governorships in Georgia, Iowa, Nevada, Ohio and Texas.
In Texas, Gina Hinojosa defeated incumbent Greg Abbott to become the first Democrat elected governor since 1990. She has pledged to halt new data center approvals until state lawmakers pass legislation protecting local communities.
During the forum, organized by the Institute for National Policy Research, Lee said Congress would seek greater involvement in tariff and technology policy.
Democrats could challenge tariffs on U.S. allies and partners, including Taiwan, while maintaining bipartisan efforts to restrict China's technological development, he said.
In a subsequent interview, Lee also played down the potential impact of state and local constraints on data center development on Taiwanese hardware suppliers.
U.S. data center owners and operators would have to address permitting requirements and community concerns before Taiwanese suppliers provided servers, power systems and cooling equipment, he said.
"There may be a slight slowdown in expansion in the short term, but the overall direction has not changed," Lee said, predicting continued growth in demand for artificial intelligence (AI).
At the forum, Ronan Fu (傅澤民), an assistant research fellow at Academia Sinica's Institute of Political Science, cautioned against interpreting the Democratic victory as a broad ideological shift.
"Voters punished Trump, but that does not mean they developed a strong attachment to the Democratic Party," Fu said.
He described the result as "retrospective voting," in which voters judged the administration on living costs and household finances.
Tariffs and the Iran war had become domestic concerns because of their effects on prices, he argued.
Also speaking at the forum, Wu Chung-li (吳重禮), director and distinguished research fellow at the same institute, warned that local political constraints could affect Taiwanese AI-related investment in the U.S.
Concerns about electricity, water and environmental burdens could impede data center development, while local authorities wielded influence over land use, construction permits and related regulations, Wu said.
Speaking separately to reporters afterward, Wu cautioned that lawmakers' focus on domestic problems could give the president greater latitude in determining foreign policy.
Taiwan would need to monitor whether U.S. arms sales continue and how quickly they proceed and rebuild congressional ties as some Taiwan-friendly lawmakers retired or lost their seats, he added.

content:
（左起）南洋理工大学协理副校长、陈六使讲席教授刘宏，新加坡中华总商会会长、联发集团执行主席高泉庆，清华大学华商研究中心主任龙登高11月3日在第十六届“华商领袖·清华讲堂”的台上交流。
新加坡中华总商会会长、联发集团执行主席高泉庆说，新加坡中华总商会在推动新中经贸合作上发挥着桥梁作用，他也强调，商会推动世界华商交流与合作时秉持“和而不同”的精神。
高泉庆星期二（11月3日）在清华大学举行的第十六届“华商领袖·清华讲堂”，发表以“‘小红点’的华商精神”为题的演讲，阐述120年来中华总商会维护华商权益、推动新中经贸合作以及传承华商精神等发展历程。
新加坡中华总商会于1906年成立，当时主要为满足南洋华侨互助通商的需求，是新加坡历史最悠久的华商跨帮派领导机构，目前拥有逾150家商协会成员，覆盖近10万家新加坡企业。
高泉庆说，在英国殖民地时代，新加坡华侨大多数仍是心系中国的家园，包括陈嘉庚先生等商界领袖，都曾慷慨捐款中国，建设学校，抗战救国。
1965年新加坡建国后，新加坡华人从“落叶归根”的心态转化成为“落地生根”。
高泉庆说，李光耀1993年在第二届世界华商大会上提到，随着“大中华”概念兴起，中国大陆、香港、台湾及海外华人的经济交流日益扩大，若将经济联系视为政治团结，视为个别华商或华人社会透过某种形式联合取得经济进展，可能会加剧一些东南亚国家的社会种族关系恶化。
因此，新加坡及中华总商会推动世界华商交流与合作时，始终强调“和而不同”，主张各国华商以效忠自身国家利益为前提，发挥中华文化凝聚力，在不同领域互惠互利、合作共赢，让各国各族共同受惠于经济发展。
谈到新中两国凭着诚信建立的深厚友谊和经贸合作，高泉庆说，总商会发挥了积极的桥梁作用。
中华总商会目前在中国已设立五个代表处，2008年发起成立“通商中国”，每年也举办多次中国商务考察团，为新中企业搭桥牵线，明年将举办疫情后第五次国际产业合作大会，促进产业链供应链合作交流，此外，总商会每年也举办新中商务论坛，畅谈新中发展大势。
南洋理工大学协理副校长、陈六使讲席教授刘宏同日在以“海外华商网络的制度化和当代转型”为题的演讲中指出，文化共通性为中国企业进入东南亚市场起到润滑作用，但非合作必然前提。
他说，中国企业走出去，与当地华商合作，需通过具体领域的利益互补，实现一加一大于二的合作效应，而非简单依赖文化纽带。
他也说，中国企业走出去已经20多年，但仍有痛点难点，包括融入文化环境的差异，缺乏有效的管理手段，以及供应链缺乏灵活性等。
而对于海外华人来说，这是一个新机遇，在于“如何在这个打造自身优势的过程中，和中国企业国际化的趋势相对接，弥补或帮助中国企业来解决这些痛点和难点”。
不过，除了机遇，事情往往还有另外一面。刘宏在马来西亚调研时发现，当地的华人企业对一些中国企业的到来并不特别欢迎，因为“中国企业带来的可能更多是竞争，如果有些中国企业出去后打价格战，对当地华商起到了很大的压力”。

content:
香港立法会议员建议东坝试行预订系统后进行旅游管理中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 4 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港立法会议员建议东坝试行预订系统后进行旅游管理
香港立法会议员姚柏龄建议在东坝引入旅游区管理，建议在破边岛段试订制结束后提供优质服务并改善设施。政府将重新审视农村长效管理制度。
立法会议员建议继万宜地质步道破边岛段试行预约制度后，在西贡水库东坝引入旅游区管理概念。该提议是在政府审查系统以制定长期乡村公园管理战略之际提出的。
选举委员会界别立法会议员姚柏龄向香港电台《政治透视》节目表示，《施政报告》宣布试行订票制度，令假期高峰期间的旅客较往年减少，人流也较顺畅。姚指出，许多短途中国大陆游客前往波平岛段游览，但恶劣的天气经常导致航班取消。他说，由于预订系统是免费的，缺席也无需支付费用。
姚建议政府检讨订票制度时，可考虑采用东坝旅游区管理概念。他建议加强设施建设，并将波平岛部分预订系统与交通和导游等增值服务相结合，以改善游客的整体体验。
政府将总结试点成果，并根据预约系统的经验制定农村长期管理策略。

Wednesday, 4 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong lawmaker suggests tourism management for East Dam after trial booking system
Hong Kong lawmaker Yiu Pak-ling proposes introducing tourism area management at East Dam, suggesting premium services and improved facilities after a trial booking system at Po Pin Island section ends. The government will review the system for long-term rural management.
A lawmaker has proposed introducing tourism area management concepts at the East Dam of the Sai Kung reservoir, following a trial booking system for the Po Pin Island section of the Wan Yi Geological Trail. The proposal comes as the government reviews the system to develop long-term rural park management strategies.
Election Committee sector lawmaker Yiu Pak-ling told RTHK programme "Political Perspectives" that the trial booking system, announced in the Policy Address, had resulted in fewer visitors during peak holiday periods compared to previous years, with smoother traffic flow. Yiu noted that many short-haul mainland Chinese tourists visited the Po Pin Island section, and that poor weather often led to cancellations. Since the booking system was free, he said, there was no cost for non-attendance.
Yiu suggested that the government could consider adopting tourism area management concepts for the East Dam in its review of the booking system. He recommended enhancing facilities and integrating the Po Pin Island section booking system with value-added services such as transport and guided tours to improve the overall visitor experience.
The government will summarise the trial's outcomes and formulate long-term rural management strategies based on the experience gained from the booking system.

香港政府检讨打击演唱会门票倒卖行为的措施中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 4 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港政府检讨打击演唱会门票倒卖行为的措施
在韩国流行音乐演唱会门票以三倍价格转售后，香港立法者质疑政府倒票行为。政府概述了现有措施，包括内部门票销售上限，并表示正在研究海外实名制系统，但必须平衡市场动态和投资者信心
有报道称，韩国男子乐队 2026 年 11 月的一场演唱会门票被黄牛以原价三倍或以上的价格转售，香港政府已就打击倒卖门票的立法问题作出回应。
政府在11月4日发表的书面回复中表示，长期以来一直关注倒票甚至假票问题，并正在研究中国内地和其他司法管辖区的做法。然而，它指出，公共娱乐是一种市场活动，造成倒卖的原因有很多，包括供给和需求。任何监管措施都必须仔细考虑其对市场反应、运营、成本效益和执行的影响，以免吓退投资者。
政府表示，《公众娱乐场所条例》（第172章）主要旨在确保场地的公共安全和秩序，包括消防安全和人群管理。禁止以高于原价转售门票的规定，旨在防止团伙滋扰和扰乱公共秩序。任何人出售、许诺出售、展示或管有高于主办单位价格出售的门票，或招揽他人购买该等门票，即属犯罪，可处罚款港币 2,000 元。
康乐及文化事务署（康文署）根据《公众卫生及市政条例》管理辖下的场地。康文署辖下禁止未经授权的售卖行为，场地工作人员和保安人员会巡逻制止此类活动，如有需要会报警。康文署过去三年并没有接获任何倒卖门票的举报，警方亦没有备存网上或实体倒票投诉的单独数字。
康文署采取行政措施，确保通过购票通票务系统公平销售门票。对于大型或热门活动，可采取实名制或抽奖制、网上销售、每人、每张信用卡限购、提前公布门票详情、延迟领取、鼓励主办方增加公开售票比例等措施。自2019年7月起，在香港红馆或伊利沙伯体育馆举办四场或以上演出的活动，内部（非公开）门票销售上限已从80%降至70%，公开销售比例下限提高至30%。许多组织者自愿提供近或超过50%的门票进行公开发售。
对于启德体育园的活动，营办商要求主办方提前公布售票安排，一般要求至少50%的门票向公众发售。运营商还要求票务平台监控购买流程，并采取封锁异常账户、设置购买限额等措施。
政府表示将继续研究该问题并咨询利益相关者。它

Hong Kong government reviews measures to combat concert ticket scalping | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 4 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong government reviews measures to combat concert ticket scalping
Hong Kong lawmakers question the government on ticket scalping after a K-pop concert saw tickets resold at triple the price. The government outlines existing measures, including caps on internal ticket sales, and says it studies overseas实名制 systems but must balance market dynamics and investor confi
The Hong Kong government has responded to legislative questions about combating ticket scalping, after reports that tickets for a November 2026 concert by a South Korean boy band were resold by scalpers at three times the original price or more.
In a written reply published on 4 November, the government said it has long been concerned about ticket scalping and even counterfeit tickets, and is studying practices in mainland China and other jurisdictions. However, it noted that public entertainment is a market activity with many causes for scalping, including supply and demand. Any regulatory measures must be carefully considered for their impact on market reaction, operations, cost-effectiveness and enforcement, so as not to deter investors.
The government said the Places of Public Entertainment Ordinance (Chapter 172) is primarily aimed at ensuring public safety and order at venues, including fire safety and crowd management. The provision banning resale of tickets above the original price was designed to prevent disturbances and public order problems caused by gangs. Anyone selling, offering to sell, displaying or possessing tickets for sale above the organiser's price, or soliciting others to buy such tickets, commits an offence punishable by a fine of HK$2,000.
The Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) manages its venues under the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance. Unauthorised sales on LCSD premises are banned, and venue staff and security personnel patrol to stop such activities, calling police if necessary. The LCSD has not received any reports of scalping in the past three years, and police do not maintain separate figures for online or physical ticket scalping complaints.
The LCSD employs administrative measures to ensure fair ticket sales through its Cityline ticketing system. For large or popular events, it may adopt real-name registration or lottery systems, online-only sales, purchase limits per person and per credit card, advance publication of ticket details, delayed collection, and encouragement for organisers to increase the proportion of publicly available tickets. Since July 2019, for events of four or more performances at the Hong Kong Coliseum or Queen Elizabeth Stadium, the cap on internal (non-public) ticket sales has been lowered from 80 per cent to 70 per cent, raising the minimum public sale share to 30 per cent. Many organisers have voluntarily offered nearly or more than 50 per cent of tickets for public sale.
For events at the Kai Tak Sports Park, the operator requires organisers to announce sales arrangements in advance and generally demands at least 50 per cent of tickets be offered to the public. The operator also mandates that ticketing platforms monitor the purchase process and take measures such as blocking abnormal accounts and setting purchase limits.
The government said it will continue studying the issue and consulting stakeholders. It urged the public to buy tickets only through official channels to avoid fraud and not to fuel scalping.

康乐及文化事务署举办演艺同乐日2026 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 4 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
康乐及文化事务署举办演艺同乐日2026
香港康乐及文化事务署将于11月连续星期日在屯门及荃湾举办免费演艺同乐日2026活动，包括舞蹈、中乐团、戏剧及家庭活动。
2026 年 11 月 4 日 12:00 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 4 日 12:19 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港康乐及文化事务署（康文署）本月将在两个场地举办免费的“演艺同乐日2026”活动，为公众提供丰富多彩的文化表演和互动活动。
第一场活动将于11月8日（星期日）下午2时在屯门大会堂举行。节目内容包括屯门艺术文化协会的舞蹈及中乐团表演、东方琴律艺术团的福建南音表演、绿叶剧团的《屯门²——浮世锈》戏剧表演、互动故事工作坊及图书展览。
第二场同乐日将于11月15日（星期日）下午2时假荃湾大会堂举行。音乐事务处将呈献由青年管弦乐团演奏的“音乐进社区”交响乐及弦乐音乐会。其他表演包括由Ensemble Plus和竹韵乐团带来的融合中西乐器的“经典又时尚”社区音乐会，以及由竹韵乐团带来的适合家庭观看的粤剧《当爱情传奇遇上黄飞鸿》。荃湾大会堂的场地合作伙伴演艺音乐剧亦将举办家庭音乐表演工作坊。
有些活动需要提前注册或购票，名额按照先到先得的原则分配。详情可浏览屯门大会堂网站(www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/tmth/pafd2026.html)及荃湾大会堂网站(www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/twth/programmes/pafd2026.html)。

Leisure and Cultural Services Department holds Performing Arts Fun Day 2026
Hong Kong's Leisure and Cultural Services Department will host free Performing Arts Fun Day 2026 events in Tuen Mun and Tsuen Wan on consecutive Sundays in November, featuring dance, Chinese orchestra, drama, and family activities.
4 Nov 2026 at 12:00 HKT · updated 4 Nov, 12:19 · 1 min read
Hong Kong's Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) will host free 'Performing Arts Fun Day 2026' events at two venues this month, offering a variety of cultural performances and interactive activities for the public.
The first event will take place at Tuen Mun Town Hall on 8 November (Sunday) at 2pm. The programme includes dance and Chinese orchestra performances by the Tuen Mun Arts and Cultural Association, Fujian Nanyin music by the Oriental Qin Melody Art Troupe, a drama presentation of 'Tuen Mun² – Rust of the Floating World' by the Green Leaf Theatre, as well as interactive story workshops and a book exhibition.
The second Fun Day will be held at Tsuen Wan Town Hall on 15 November (Sunday) at 2pm. The Music Office will present a 'Music in the Community' symphony and string concert performed by a youth orchestra. Other acts include a 'Classic but Trendy' community music concert blending Chinese and Western instruments by the Ensemble Plus and the Zhuyun Ensemble, and a family-friendly Cantonese opera theatre piece, 'When the Legend of Love Meets Wong Fei Hung', performed by the Zhuyun Ensemble. The Tsuen Wan Town Hall's venue partner, the Yanyi Musical, will also offer a family musical performance workshop.
Some activities require advance registration or tickets, with places allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Further details are available on the Tuen Mun Town Hall website (www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/tmth/pafd2026.html) and the Tsuen Wan Town Hall website (www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/twth/programmes/pafd2026.html).

summary: 香港政府概述临终规划“三大保障”方面的进展 |中国劳工布告栏 星期三，2026 年 11 月 4 日·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港政府概述临终规划“三项保障”的进展 香港政府向立法会更新了“三项保障”——遗嘱、持久授权书和预先医疗指示。它表示，目前没有计划将持久授权书扩大到涵盖个人护理，并且此类文件的跨境认可
content:
香港政府概述临终规划“三大保障”方面的进展 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 4 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港政府概述临终规划“三大保障”方面的进展
香港政府向立法会更新了“三项保障”——遗嘱、持久授权书和预先医疗指示。它表示，目前没有计划扩大持久授权书以涵盖个人护理，并且此类文件的跨境认可
香港政府向立法会提供了关于“三项保障”——遗嘱、持久授权书（EPA）和预先医疗指示（AMD）——实施和推广的详细最新情况，允许居民提前规划资产管理、财产继承和医疗愿望。
政府在回应立法会议员颜俊贤的提问时表示，经咨询律政司、卫生局、民政青年局、文化体育及旅游局和创新及科技局后，表示暂时没有计划立法扩大持久授权书的范围，以涵盖个人护理决定。法改会于2011年提出此建议，并于2017年就法案草稿进行公众咨询。但2022年接手此事的劳工及福利局，以现有涵盖个人护理的金融产品和最近颁布的《维持生命治疗决定条例》为由，认为没有迫切需要。
在为这三份文件建立官方自愿登记系统时，政府表示，它会定期审查电子服务的可行性，但指出，对于遗嘱和持久授权书而言，这涉及多项法令下的复杂法律和政策问题。对于 AMD，政府正在实施分阶段的电子服务。第一阶段已经生效，允许纸质 AMD 持有者通过注册医生将其上传到电子医疗系统。第二阶段预计到 2027 年，通过 eHealth 以电子方式创建 AMD。
在公共教育方面，政府表示各部门正在积极开展工作。卫生局长者健康外展小组于2025年至2026年9月期间举办超过450场健康讲座，主题包括临终关怀，覆盖超过9,900名长者及护老者。医院管理局「智慧之友」平台及「智慧宝典」研讨会系列举办四场有关预先护理规划及提前护理计划的分享会，吸引超过2,100人参加。民政及青年局透过各区民政事务处及其遗产受益人支援组派发新的遗嘱单张。
关于文件的跨境认可，特别是与中国大陆的文件认可，政府承认遗嘱认证机制和继承程序存在差异。它表示相互承认并不容易，并将密切关注事态发展。对于虚拟资产或海外特殊目的工具等资产，政府指出，《持久授权书条例》笼统地涵盖“财产和财务事务”，但其法律效力仅限于香港。建议就此类资产寻求专业法律意见，并按照内地程序处理内地资产。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong government outlines progress on 'Three Safeguards' for end-of-life planning | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 4 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong government outlines progress on 'Three Safeguards' for end-of-life planning
Hong Kong's government updated the Legislative Council on the 'Three Safeguards' – wills, enduring powers of attorney, and advance medical directives. It said there are no immediate plans to expand enduring powers of attorney to cover personal care, and that cross-border recognition of such document
The Hong Kong government has provided a detailed update to the Legislative Council on the implementation and promotion of the so-called 'Three Safeguards' – wills, enduring powers of attorney (EPA), and advance medical directives (AMD) – which allow residents to plan for asset management, property inheritance and medical wishes in advance.
In response to a question from lawmaker Ngan Chun-yin, the government, after consulting the Department of Justice, the Health Bureau, the Home and Youth Affairs Bureau, the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and the Innovation, Science and Technology Bureau, said it has no immediate plans to legislate on expanding the scope of EPAs to cover personal care decisions. The Law Reform Commission had proposed this in 2011, and a public consultation on a draft bill was held in 2017. However, the Labour and Welfare Bureau, which took over the matter in 2022, determined there was no urgent need, citing existing financial products covering personal care and the recently enacted Making Decisions on Life-sustaining Treatment Ordinance.
On establishing an official voluntary registration system for the three documents, the government said it regularly reviews the feasibility of electronic services but noted that for wills and EPAs this involves complex legal and policy issues under multiple ordinances. For AMDs, the government is implementing a phased e-service. The first phase, already in effect, allows holders of paper AMDs to upload them to the eHealth system via a registered doctor. The second phase, enabling electronic creation of AMDs through eHealth, is expected by 2027.
Regarding public education, the government said various departments are active. The Health Bureau's elderly health outreach teams held over 450 health talks on topics including end-of-life care between 2025 and September 2026, reaching more than 9,900 elderly people and carers. The Hospital Authority's 'Friends of Wisdom' platform and 'Wisdom Collection' seminar series held four sharing sessions on advance care planning and AMDs, with over 2,100 participants. The Home and Youth Affairs Bureau distributes a new leaflet on wills through district offices and its Estate Beneficiaries Support Unit.
On cross-border recognition of documents, particularly with mainland China, the government acknowledged differences in probate mechanisms and inheritance procedures. It said mutual recognition is not easy and that it will monitor the situation. For assets like virtual assets or overseas special purpose vehicles, the government noted that the Enduring Powers of Attorney Ordinance covers 'property and financial affairs' in a general manner, but its legal effect is limited to Hong Kong. It advised seeking professional legal advice for such assets and for handling mainland assets according to mainland procedures.

Typhoon Champi causes damage across Taiwan
Typhoon Champi brought strong winds, heavy rain and massive waves to Taiwan on Friday, causing widespread damage across the country. In eastern Taitung County, powerful waves knocked a large crane into the sea at Fugang Fishing Harbor, while an uprooted tree struck a passing truck in the southern port city of Kaohsiung, injuring two people. Strong winds also caused damage in Taichung and the capital, Taipei, while coastal roads in outlying Orchid Island (Lanyu) were damaged by huge waves.

Chinese V American Views On WAR With Taiwan | Armstrong Economics Skip to content
Blog War Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

content:
Author, 加里·奥多诺霍（Gary O'Donoghue）
Author, 布兰登·德雷农（Brandon Drenon）
民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科（James Talarico）赢得德克萨斯州（Texas；得州）关键的参议员选举，被视为今次美国中期选举的最大爆冷之一。
他击败共和党对手肯·帕克斯顿（Ken Paxton），是1988年以来首次有民主党人在德州赢得联邦参议员席位。这场胜利不仅改写德州数十年来的政治版图，也进一步巩固民主党对美国国会的控制。
塔拉里科是教师出身，直到去年之前都鲜为人知。他将共和党执政下生活成本上升作为竞选主轴，争取选民支持。
共和党的帕克斯顿则曾多次与特朗普（Donald Trump；川普）同台造势，并将塔拉里科描绘成对德州而言过于进步的候选人。
此文包含Instagram提供的内容。由于这些内容会使用曲奇或小甜饼等科技，我们在加载任何内容前会寻求您的认可。 您可能在给与许可前愿意阅读Instagram小甜饼政策和隐私政策。 希望阅读上述内容，请点击“接受并继续”。
在德州首府奥斯汀的一场观票派对上，当电视宣布塔拉里科胜选时，他的支持者陷入狂欢。
他们拥抱、亲吻、举杯庆祝。许多人说，自己不敢相信这会实现。
塔拉里科在附近一间表演艺术中心的正式观票派对上登台，现场掌声雷动。他宣布：“我们刚刚夺回了德州。”
“我们证明了，再多的金钱也比不上德州人民的力量。”
这是指他击败了共和党对手帕克斯顿，而帕克斯顿的竞选活动获全球首富马斯克（Elon Musk）的支持。
他竞选期间常用宗教语言，把自己的胜算渺茫，比作《圣经》中“大卫战胜歌利亚”的故事。
他说：“这场胜利，是献给每一位曾经怀疑是否有人在聆听的德州人。我听见你们了，我们听见你们了。今晚，全世界都听见你们了。”
Play video, "為何美國中期選舉對特朗普至關重要？", 节目全长 8,18
数十年来，对德州的自由派来说，民主党人赢得全州性选举，一直像是白日梦。
德州是美国人口第二多的州，一直是保守主义的堡垒，经常推行日后被其他地方效法的共和党政策。
但在整个竞选期间，民调显示身为州议员的塔拉里科，逐渐突破传统政治版图，激励了急切渴望新领导层的德州民主党基本盘。
选战开支也随之大幅飙升，很快成为美国联邦参议员选举史上最昂贵的一场，花费超过5亿美元（36亿元人民币；150亿元新台币）。
马斯克向支持共和党帕克斯顿的超级政治行动委员会（Super PAC），注资1.58亿美元，而这也成为塔拉里科攻击对手的重要素材。
更令人意外的是，以德州作为政治根据地的共和党政治世家布什家族（Bush family；布希／布殊），竟有两名成员公开支持塔拉里科，此举被视为帕克斯顿败选的预兆。
乔治华盛顿大学（George Washington University）政治学教授夸德里科斯·德里斯克尔（Prof Quardricos Driskell）向BBC表示，帕克斯顿是共和党失败的主要原因之一，称他是“客观而言糟糕的候选人”。
他说，塔拉里科在德州的胜利，加上周二（11月3日）另一场爆冷，击败了该州共和党籍州长阿博特（Greg Abbott），“绝对是历史性的”。阿博特落败，也意味着民主党自1990年代以来首次赢得德州州长选举。
德里斯克尔教授谈到民主党在这个“孤星之州”的收获时说：“这不只是海啸，不只是公投，而是一场血洗。⋯⋯这明确显示，这个国家想走向不同的方向。”
塔拉里科在民主党初选中，击败了知名对手、达拉斯国会议员贾丝敏·克罗基特（Jasmine Crockett）。
此后，尽管面对大量负面广告攻击，包括针对他过去支持跨性别者权益的言论，他的支持度仍维持稳定。
竞选期间，他经常谈及自己的宗教背景。他的祖父是一名南方浸信会（Southern Baptist）牧师，而他本人也曾在神学院学习，因此演说中经常引用《圣经》典故。
Play video, "The expensive battle to turn Texas blue", 节目全长 0,31
2023年，他被自己所属政党以贪腐指控弹劾，后来获该州参议院宣判无罪。他也曾遭美国证券交易委员会（SEC）以联邦诈欺罪名起诉，但案件后来被撤控。
特朗普则多次赴德州，替帕克斯顿及其他共和党候选人站台，甚至前往原本稳定支持共和党的地区举办造势活动，显示共和党高层对投票率感到忧心。
选民对高昂的物价感到不满，包括汽油价格，并将原因归咎于特朗普的关税政策及对伊朗战争。
此外，美墨边境地区及拉丁裔选民亦对特朗普移民政策感到不满。
尽管特朗普执政下非法越境人数大幅下降，而这一直是德州选民重视的议题，但民调显示，特朗普在拉丁裔选民中的支持度明显流失。
拉丁裔约占德州总人口三分之一。自夏末以来的多项调查显示，多数德州拉丁裔选民如今不认同特朗普的施政，而许多人曾在2024年大选中转而支持他。
多位在选前接受BBC访问的德州拉丁裔选民表示，促使他们改变立场的重要原因之一，是特朗普强力打击移民的政策。
他们提到，部分执法措施导致美国公民遭拘留，非暴力犯罪者也被大规模逮捕，让许多人感到不安。

Defense Minister Wellington Koo. CNA file photo
Taipei, Nov. 5 (CNA) Taiwan's defense minister said Thursday that U.S. congressional support for Taiwan's efforts to strengthen its defense capabilities has long been bipartisan, in response to a question about the Republican Party's major losses in Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections.
"The U.S. Congress has consistently supported -- on a bipartisan basis -- Taiwan's efforts to beef up its defense capabilities," Defense Minister Wellington Koo (顧立雄) told reporters in Taipei while attending a legislative session.
He added that the Ministry of National Defense would continue engaging with members of Congress and maintaining close contact with the U.S. Department of War to help keep arms sales to Taiwan on schedule.
Democrats won majorities in both the Senate and the House of Representatives in the Nov. 3 elections, taking control of Congress for the remainder of President Donald Trump's term.
Newly elected lawmakers are scheduled to be sworn in on Jan. 3, 2027.
In an interview with The New York Times later Tuesday, Trump said he was willing to accept the election results and work with Democrats.

（中央社華盛頓3日綜合外電報導）美國聯邦當局起訴一名來自奧克拉荷馬市的男子，指控他在2024年與2026年選舉前，寄送數以百計含有白色粉末的信件給公職人員，信內並附有關於叛國罪的不祥警告。
美聯社報導，美國聯邦調查局（FBI）在今天公開的法庭文件中表示，這些粉末最後發現沒有危害，成分是酵母或麵粉，但並非所有信件都完成檢驗。
馬丁（Robin Martin）遭控傳播虛假訊息並郵寄具威脅性的信件。他於昨天遭到逮捕，預計今天將在奧克拉荷馬市（Oklahoma City）聯邦地區法院出庭。
FBI表示，這起調查可追溯至2024年，當時多個州的選務官員通報收到內含白色物質的郵件，裡面還放了一封長達3頁、宣稱要發動戰爭的信件。其中一些信件含有透過紫外線才能看到的警告字句，像是「站在歷史正確的一邊！你的生命可能取決於此！！」
寄件者在回郵地址欄寫上「美國叛國者剷除軍（U.S.T.E.A., United States Traitor Elimination Army），馬里蘭州塔科馬帕克市（Takoma Park）」。
調查人員認為，今年秋天寄出的700多封郵件似乎與同一名寄件者有關，但使用不同的回郵地址。FBI探員柯爾（David Cole）在宣誓書中指出，這些郵件寄給選務官員、國會議員、民調機構、新聞媒體與聯邦執法機構。
在2024年與2026年寄出的郵件中，常見的訊息是警告收件者，他們將因叛國罪「或更嚴重的罪名！！」遭到逮捕。
柯爾說：「這封信件的寄件人描述他所認為的2020年選舉問題，聲稱總統川普贏得2020年大選，並擔憂部分相同問題可能在即將舉行的2024年選舉中再次浮現。」
聯邦當局上月宣布，正在調查寄往全美各地國會與選舉辦公室、內含「可疑物質」的信件，並呼籲收件者將這些信件視為可能具危險性。（編譯：張曉雯）1151104

content:
跑马地比赛日：中午或下午6点起特别交通安排 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 4 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
跑马地比赛日：中午或下午6点起实施特别交通安排
香港警方宣布，跑马地比赛日将实行封路和交通改道，白天比赛从中午开始，晚上比赛从下午 6 点开始，决赛前还会实施额外限制，并禁止学习驾驶员。
香港特别行政区政府于 2026 年 11 月 4 日宣布，香港警方宣布在跑马地马场比赛日实施特别交通及运输安排，日间赛马会从中午开始实施，晚间赛马会则从下午 6 点开始实施。
首场比赛前，介乎皇后大道东至香港赛马会外上山支路的圆园路南行车道将会封闭，但前往香港仔隧道的车辆除外。介乎山珍路与赛马会外上山支路之间的圆园路南行车道将成为单向北行道路。
沿皇后大道东东行前往湾仔及跑马地的车辆必须左转入摩理臣山道。经摩利臣山道向南往跑马地的车辆必须使用体育路及圆园路。除前往香港仔隧道的车辆外，任何车辆不得由皇后大道东右转入圆园路。
由海底隧道往皇后大道东方向的车辆须经坚拿道天桥南行、下坡支路往摩利臣山道，然后在圆园道与皇后大道东交界处右转。车辆由海底隧道前往跑马地或马场时，必须使用坚拿道天桥南行、往坚拿道东的下坡支路、摩理臣山道南行、体育路及圆园路。
决赛前约35分钟，将实施额外封闭：赛马会外圆园路通往香港仔隧道的上坡支路；介乎皇后大道东与通往香港仔隧道的上坡支路之间的圆园路南行车道；介乎山珍路与赛马会公众看台之间的圆园路南行车道；介乎礼顿道与皇后大道东的摩利臣山道南行车道。距离决赛前约十分钟，介乎香港仔隧道上山支路与赛马会公众看台之间的圆园路南行车道亦会关闭。
首场比赛前一小时三十分钟至决赛后一小时期间，学习车手不得由加路连道左转入礼顿道，亦不得进入指定道路，包括山桂道、山俊道、波斯富街、坚拿道东，以及告士打道至坚拿道天桥的支路。介乎体育路与蓝塘道之间的圆园路南行车道的停车位将于日间比赛日上午 11 时至晚上 7 时及晚间比赛日下午 5 时至晚上 11 时 59 分暂停使用。警方表示，非法停放的车辆将在没有警告的情况下被拖走或开出罚单。

Wednesday, 4 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Happy Valley race days: special traffic arrangements from noon or 6pm
Hong Kong police announce road closures and traffic diversions for Happy Valley race days, starting from noon for daytime meetings or 6pm for evening meetings, with additional restrictions before the final race and a ban on learner drivers.
Hong Kong police have announced special traffic and transport arrangements for race days at Happy Valley Racecourse, effective from noon for daytime race meetings or 6pm for evening race meetings, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government announced on 4 November 2026.
Before the first race, the southbound carriageway of Yuen Yuen Road between Queen's Road East and the uphill slip road outside the Hong Kong Jockey Club will be closed, except for vehicles heading to Aberdeen Tunnel. The southbound carriageway of Yuen Yuen Road between Shan Chun Road and the uphill slip road outside the Jockey Club will become a one-way northbound road.
Vehicles travelling eastbound on Queen's Road East towards Wan Chai and Happy Valley must turn left onto Morrison Hill Road. Vehicles heading south on Morrison Hill Road towards Happy Valley must use Sports Road and Yuen Yuen Road. No vehicles, except those heading to Aberdeen Tunnel, may turn right from Queen's Road East onto Yuen Yuen Road.
Vehicles coming from the Harbour Tunnel towards Queen's Road East must use the southbound Canal Road Flyover, the downhill slip road to Morrison Hill Road, then turn right at the junction of Yuen Yuen Road and Queen's Road East. Vehicles from the Harbour Tunnel towards Happy Valley or the racecourse must use the southbound Canal Road Flyover, the downhill slip road to Canal Road East, Morrison Hill Road southbound, Sports Road and Yuen Yuen Road.
Approximately 35 minutes before the final race, additional closures will take effect: the uphill slip road of Yuen Yuen Road leading to Aberdeen Tunnel outside the Jockey Club; the southbound carriageway of Yuen Yuen Road between Queen's Road East and the uphill slip road to Aberdeen Tunnel; the southbound carriageway of Yuen Yuen Road between Shan Chun Road and the Jockey Club public stand; and the southbound carriageway of Morrison Hill Road between Leighton Road and Queen's Road East. About ten minutes before the final race, the southbound carriageway of Yuen Yuen Road between the uphill slip road to Aberdeen Tunnel and the Jockey Club public stand will also close.
Learner drivers are banned from turning left from Caroline Road onto Leighton Road, and from entering specified roads including Shan Kwai Road, Shan Chun Road, Percival Street, Canal Road East, and the slip road from Gloucester Road to Canal Road Flyover, from one hour 30 minutes before the first race until one hour after the final race. Parking spaces on the southbound carriageway of Yuen Yuen Road between Sports Road and Blue Pool Road will be suspended from 11am to 7pm on daytime race days and from 5pm to 11.59pm on evening race days. Illegally parked vehicles will be towed or ticketed without warning, police said.

zh_title: 香港政府解决对观赏池塘中动物的担忧
summary: 香港政府解决对观赏池塘中动物的担忧中国劳工布告栏 星期三, 4 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港政府解决对观赏池塘中动物的担忧 香港政府回应了有关观赏池塘中动物的立法问题，表示没有关于公共和私人财产中此类池塘的全面统计数据。它概述了管理这些池塘中动物的现有措施，包括农业部的指导。香港政府已经解决了立法问题
content:
香港政府解决对观赏池塘中动物的担忧中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 4 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港政府解决对观赏池塘中动物的担忧
香港政府回应了有关观赏性池塘饲养动物的立法问题，表示没有关于公共和私人财产中此类池塘的全面统计数据。它概述了管理这些池塘中动物的现有措施，包括农业部的指导
香港政府已解决有关饲养在观赏池塘中的动物的立法问题，确认没有完整的统计数据来说明私人屋村、居者有其屋计划屋村、公共租住屋村或康乐及文化事务署公园内最初为美观目的而设计但现在用于饲养动物的池塘的数量。
政府在2026年11月4日给立法会议员何俊轩的书面答复中表示，康乐及文化事务署和房屋委员会并没有追踪其物业的此类数据，政府也没有掌握私人物业的数据。政府辩称，由于服务承包商在清洁和维护过程中需要妥善处理观赏池塘中发现的任何动物，因此此类统计数据是不必要的。
政府概述康乐及文化事务署和房屋委员会的服务合约规定承建商每日清除池塘垃圾并定期清洁，费用已计入合约总价。承包商必须妥善处理在观赏池塘中发现的任何动物，并指示现场工作人员在巡逻期间停止遗弃或释放动物。
为协助物业管理人员，渔农自然护理署已透过《物业管理从业者条例》，向康乐及文化事务署、房屋委员会和所有物业管理公司提供实用指引。这些准则涵盖动物福利、水质标准、过滤和曝气系统、池塘清洁安排以及定期监测。欲从池塘移走动物的物业管理公司必须确保妥善搬迁，并可联络动物福利组织或致电1823转介至渔农自然护理署动物管理中心。
根据《防止虐待动物条例》，不当释放动物而造成不必要痛苦的行为属违法，最高可被罚款港币20万元及监禁三年。执法机构可以根据证据起诉个人、物业经理或承包商。通过不当程序造成动物大规模死亡的清洁承包商也可能违反该条例。
为防止不当放生动物，渔农自然护理署会在特定节日期间在放生热点加强巡逻，并在公共交通枢纽和放生地点张贴教育海报和横幅。自2024年起，该部门在每年6月6日“全国鱼类放流日”推动科学放流活动，邀请宗教团体、渔民组织、环保团体和学生参与全国同步放流，改善渔业资源和海洋生态。

Hong Kong government addresses concerns over animals in ornamental ponds | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 4 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong government addresses concerns over animals in ornamental ponds
The Hong Kong government has responded to legislative questions about animals kept in ornamental ponds, stating that no comprehensive statistics exist on such ponds across public and private properties. It outlined existing measures to manage animals in these ponds, including guidance from the Agric
The Hong Kong government has addressed legislative questions about animals kept in ornamental ponds, confirming that no comprehensive statistics are maintained on the number of ponds originally designed for aesthetic purposes but now used to house animals across private housing estates, Home Ownership Scheme estates, public rental housing estates, or Leisure and Cultural Services Department parks.
In a written reply on 4 November 2026 to lawmaker Ho Chun-hin, the government said the Leisure and Cultural Services Department and the Housing Authority do not track such data for their properties, nor does the government hold figures for private properties. The government argued that since service contractors are required to properly handle any animals found in ornamental ponds during cleaning and maintenance, such statistics are unnecessary.
The government outlined that service contracts for the Leisure and Cultural Services Department and the Housing Authority require contractors to remove rubbish from ponds daily and clean them regularly, with costs included in the total contract price. Contractors must properly handle any animals found in ornamental ponds, and site staff are instructed to stop any abandonment or release of animals during patrols.
To assist property managers, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department has provided practical guidelines to the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the Housing Authority, and all property management companies through the Property Management Practitioners Ordinance. These guidelines cover animal welfare, water quality standards, filtration and aeration systems, pond cleaning arrangements, and regular monitoring. Property management companies seeking to remove animals from ponds must ensure proper relocation and may contact animal welfare organisations or call 1823 for referral to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department's animal management centre.
Under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Ordinance, improper release of animals causing unnecessary suffering is illegal, carrying a maximum fine of HK$200,000 and three years' imprisonment. Enforcement agencies may prosecute individuals, property managers, or contractors based on evidence. Cleaning contractors who cause mass animal deaths through improper procedures may also violate the ordinance.
To prevent improper release of animals, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department conducts enhanced patrols at release hotspots during specific festivals and displays educational posters and banners at public transport hubs and release sites. Since 2024, the department has promoted science-based stock enhancement activities on 6 June each year, National Fish Release Day, inviting religious groups, fishermen's organisations, environmental groups, and students to participate in nationwide simultaneous releases to improve fishery resources and marine ecology.

summary: 韩国晶片制造商SK海力士计划通过扩大在华生产，为纽约新建存储晶片工厂筹资，但所需美国设备的出口许可据报迟迟未获批准，令公司赴美投资计划受阻。 （路透社档案照片） 韩国晶片制造商SK海力士计划通过扩大在华生产，为纽约新建存储晶片工厂筹资，但所需美国设备的出口许可据报迟迟未获批准，令公司赴美投资计划受阻。 据路透社报道，SK海力士正申请美国出口许可证，为大连工厂添置设备。公司认为，提高该厂产量、发展更先进的NAND晶片制造技术，既有助于保持竞争力，也能创造收入，支持美国建厂计划。
content:
韩国晶片制造商SK海力士计划通过扩大在华生产，为纽约新建存储晶片工厂筹资，但所需美国设备的出口许可据报迟迟未获批准，令公司赴美投资计划受阻。 （路透社档案照片）
韩国晶片制造商SK海力士计划通过扩大在华生产，为纽约新建存储晶片工厂筹资，但所需美国设备的出口许可据报迟迟未获批准，令公司赴美投资计划受阻。
据路透社报道，SK海力士正申请美国出口许可证，为大连工厂添置设备。公司认为，提高该厂产量、发展更先进的NAND晶片制造技术，既有助于保持竞争力，也能创造收入，支持美国建厂计划。
两名知情人士称，SK海力士旗下Solidigm计划投资约450亿美元，在纽约州马西（Marcy）兴建两座NAND闪存工厂，长期投资额可能达到约1000亿美元。NAND闪存在断电后仍能保存数据，可用于数据中心存储。
知情人士说，谈判仍在继续，大连工厂扩张计划能否获批，是纽约建厂计划的关键。这也凸显特朗普政府面临的政策两难：为了吸引外资、推动晶片制造回流美国，政府愿意在多大程度上放宽旨在防止美国技术助力中国军方的限制。
美国国会设立的跨党派机构美中经济与安全评估委员会委员米勒（Leland Miller）说：“归根结底，如果没有白宫开绿灯，这些计划都无法推进。”
自8月底以来，Solidigm高管已与美国商务部官员会面近10次。在8月底的一次会议上，Solidigm联席首席执行官Richard Chin及其他高管，与美国商务部长卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick）和次长凯斯勒（Jeffrey Kessler）会面。
知情人士称，两名官员当时似乎对潜在投资和在美国兴建NAND工厂抱有期待，也有意寻求解决方案。此后，公司与商务部持续调整申请内容，已拟出多个版本的许可申请。
不过，凯斯勒在上周的会议上仍坚持，美国不希望允许更多美国晶片制造设备输往中国，用于技术升级或扩大产能。商务部目前尚未正式驳回向大连工厂现有闲置洁净室出口设备的许可申请。
双方也在就另一份2027年度许可证进行谈判，涉及维持大连工厂运作所需的设备。
Solidigm上周发表声明说：“作为一家在美国创立、总部设在美国的公司，Solidigm定期评估战略选项，以更好地服务客户，提升长期竞争力。公司目前正探索在全球潜在地点兴建NAND闪存晶圆厂的选项，尚未就任何具体行动方案作出决定。”
Solidigm此次仍沿用上周的声明。SK海力士未立即回应在非办公时间发出的置评请求。
知情人士说，公司代表也与美国财政部官员会面。SK海力士若要为中国工厂购买设备，还须获得财政部对对外投资限制的豁免。财政部回应说，将先观察商务部如何处理。
SK海力士在10月23日的声明中说，Solidigm此前曾考虑首次公开售股（IPO），以协助筹资建设美国生产设施，满足不断增长的存储需求，但鉴于近期市场状况和股价走势，已暂停评估上市选项。
SK海力士在2020年同意以90亿美元收购英特尔位于中国大连的NAND工厂，随后接管该厂及固态硬盘存储业务。此后不久，美国实施广泛出口管制，限制向认定为中国先进晶片工厂的设施出口美国晶片制造设备。
美国最初给予在华外资晶片工厂相关豁免，但商务部去年撤销了允许这些工厂接收美国设备的授权，并改为发放年度许可证，允许供应商在规定数量内向这些工厂出口特定设备和技术。
美国商务部在2025年8月的声明中明确指出，无意为中国境内晶圆厂的技术升级或产能扩张发放许可证。
SK海力士则主张，向大连工厂的闲置空间添置设备不属于扩大产能，因为相关洁净室早在2023年就已建成。路透社上月报道，公司也希望在大连生产更先进的NAND产品。

content:
Fundraiser by tyrone thomas : Unite for Digital Fearlessness
tyrone thomas is organizing this fundraiser.
"Use what's in your hand" - Adam Clayton Powell Jr.
Your phone isn't just for posting stories and playing music. That little computer in your pocket has more power than entire governments had 20 years ago. Like the ancient Abhaya Mudra - the fearless hand gesture that banishes fear and offers protection from the "Evil Eye" - we're transforming these devices into something that helps communities meet the coming challenges with a sense of fearlessness, rooted in Free Collaboration and Privacy.
Abhaya started as disaster recovery - how do communities rebuild communication when the towers are down and the power's out? But we realized something profound: the same tools that help neighborhoods coordinate after a hurricane are exactly what we need when authoritarians try to silence us. Like the protective Abhaya Mudra, this system creates a shield against the "evil eye" of surveillance while becoming a helpful digital companion that guides and empowers our communities.
Drawing inspiration from Buckminster Fuller's vision of global cooperation for humanity's benefit, Abhaya is designed as the foundation for communities to work together toward a more equitable future. The ecosystem operates through five interconnected elements:
• Tor + Mobile based Mesh Networks: Messages that flow around censorship like water
• Mesh Based Distributed Storage: Truth that lives everywhere so it can't be destroyed
• Mesh Based Distributed Computation Service: AI-capable shared processing power for communities to solve their own challenges
• Sensor/Peripheral IO: User Controlled Eyes and ears embedded in the network
• Mesh Federation: Connecting local networks into unstoppable global resistance
"The ultimate measure of a man is not where he stands in moments of comfort and convenience, but where he stands at times of challenge and controversy." - MLK Jr.
After Hurricane Katrina, communities learned they couldn't wait for official help. Hong Kong protesters used mesh networks when the government tried to cut them off. Iranian women shared videos of police brutality when the state blocked social media. Puerto Ricans coordinated mutual aid through amateur radio when Maria destroyed the grid.
The pattern is clear: when systems fail - whether from natural disasters or deliberate suppression - communities need tools to build their own infrastructure. Communities united in purpose and vision can be powerful.
When you contribute to Abhaya, you're investing in infrastructure that makes communities fearless. No CEO can sell it. No government can buy it. No algorithm can suppress it. No storm can wash it away.
Every dollar helps us turn individual devices into collective power. Like Powell said - we're not waiting for someone to save us. We're using what's already in our hands to build the infrastructure of fearlessness.
Fund the network that makes communities fearless.
We're assembling an international team of developers and engineers who understand that code is power, and power should belong to the people. If you're a technologist looking to put your skills toward meaningful resistance, this is how you push back against authoritarianism and corporate overreach.
• Onion Router, I2P, Freenet protocols
• DevOps/SecOps fluent in Dark Web technologies
This is open-source work with no revenue model - Abhaya is designed to be free for all communities. For technologists feeling the weight of current events, it's a concrete way to turn skills into direct action and fulfill civic duty through code. Ready to put your shoulder to the wheel of progress? Reach out.
Because true community care means building the infrastructure that makes us all fearless.

content:
贸易局主席表示，香港在中国进口博览会上领先70多家企业|中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
贸易局主席表示，香港带领70多家企业参加中国进口博览会
贸易发展局主席马骏表示，该局带领70多家香港企业参加中国进口博览会，参展商数量和展览面积创历史新高。他概述了配合国家和特区战略、利用香港作为超级联系人的计划。
第九届中国国际进口博览会暨虹桥国际经济论坛正在上海举行。香港贸易发展局主席马天宇在虹桥论坛香港分论坛上表示，贸发局将主动对接国家发展战略和香港特区政府政策。
马云表示，贸发局将充分发挥香港的“超级联系人”和“超级增值者”作用，不断优化其全球51个办事处网络、大型国际展览会议以及“走出去”计划等支持服务。这些举措旨在进一步促进资金、人才、技术高效流动，深化国际经贸合作。
马云表示，今年是国家“十五五”规划的开局之年，香港特区也公布了第一个五年规划。他表示，香港具有“背靠祖国、连通世界”的独特优势。贸发局将协助香港企业把握国家“十五五”规划机遇，同时支持内地企业利用香港的专业服务和国际化营商平台开拓新市场、提升全球竞争力，为高质量发展和高标准对外开放作出贡献。
马英九透露，今年贸发局带领70多家香港企业参展，设立“香港美食馆”和“香港服务馆”。参展企业数量和展览面积均创历史新高。他说，美食广场包括一个新的“香港品牌区”，而服务馆的主题是“香港门户 – 连接世界”。展馆亦展示贸发局的“走出去”计划，旨在支持内地企业拓展海外业务，配合专业服务，并利用贸发局的旗舰活动和全球网络，与香港一起“走出去”。

Hong Kong leads over 70 firms at China import expo, says trade bureau chair | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 5 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong leads over 70 firms at China import expo, says trade bureau chair
Trade Development Council chair Fred Ma says the bureau leads over 70 Hong Kong firms at the China import expo, with record exhibitor numbers and floor space. He outlines plans to align with national and SAR strategies, leveraging Hong Kong as a super-connector.
The ninth China International Import Expo and Hongqiao International Economic Forum is under way in Shanghai. Fred Ma, chairman of the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (TDC), told the Hongqiao Forum's Hong Kong sub-forum that the TDC will proactively align with national development strategies and the Hong Kong SAR government's policies.
Ma said the TDC will fully leverage Hong Kong's role as a 'super-connector' and 'super-value-adder', continuously optimising its network of 51 global offices, large-scale international exhibitions and conferences, and support services such as the 'Go Global' scheme. These efforts aim to further facilitate the efficient flow of capital, talent and technology, deepening international economic and trade cooperation.
Ma noted that this year marks the start of the nation's 15th five-year plan, and the Hong Kong SAR has announced its first five-year plan. Hong Kong, he said, enjoys the unique advantage of 'backed by the motherland, connected to the world'. The TDC will help Hong Kong enterprises seize opportunities under the national 15th five-year plan while supporting mainland companies in using Hong Kong's professional services and international business platform to explore new markets and enhance global competitiveness, contributing to high-quality development and high-standard opening up.
Ma revealed that the TDC is leading a total of more than 70 Hong Kong companies at this year's expo, setting up a 'Hong Kong Food Hall' and a 'Hong Kong Services Pavilion'. Both the number of exhibitors and exhibition area have reached record highs. He said the food hall includes a new 'Hong Kong Brands Zone', while the services pavilion is themed 'Hong Kong Gateway – Connecting the World'. The pavilion will also showcase the TDC's 'Go Global' scheme, designed to support mainland enterprises looking to expand overseas by pairing them with professional services and leveraging the TDC's flagship events and global network to go global together with Hong Kong.

中新社台北11月5日电 台北检方周四表示，一名立法助理因腐败指控于9月被起诉后潜逃，并扣押了与此案有关的第二艘渔船，他们已扩大对他涉嫌乘船逃亡的调查范围。
台北地检署在一份简短声明中表示，周三，满瑞富6号渔船在基隆正滨渔港被扣押，五名船员——一名陈姓中国公民和四名印度尼西亚公民——受到讯问。
渔船Man Jui Fu 6被海岸警卫队扣押。中央通讯社照片2026年11月4日
检方称，这五名船员以及船主李姓和船长黄姓，因涉嫌参与独立议员高金素梅前立法室主任张俊杰案件，计划接受进一步讯问。
据称，张于10月28日晚首次在基隆正滨渔港登上一艘名为“钱春168号”的渔船，随后被“万瑞富6”号在海上接走。
独立议员高金素梅前立法室主任张俊杰（左）在调查员的陪同下。 CNA档案照片
张是6月被台北地检署起诉的24人之一，罪名是与高进合谋挪用公共助理费，违反《反腐败法》。
9月6日，他在台北大安森林公园打破​​电子监控腕带，并以1000万新台币（304,634美元）保释期间，此后他已逃亡近两个月，促使台北地方法院对他发出逮捕令。
据台湾高检署称，高进的前助手也在另一起案件中接受调查，指控他接受中国的资金在台湾建立间谍网络，违反了国家安全法。

Taipei prosecutors expand probe into aide's suspected boat escape

The Taipei District Prosecutors Office. CNA file photo
Taipei, Nov. 5 (CNA) Taipei prosecutors said Thursday they have expanded a probe into a legislative aide's suspected escape by boat after he jumped bail in September following his indictment on corruption charges, seizing a second fishing vessel in connection with the case.
In a brief statement, the Taipei District Prosecutors Office said the fishing boat Man Jui Fu 6 (滿瑞富6號) was seized at Zhengbin Fishing Port in Keelung on Wednesday, during which five crew members -- a Chinese national surnamed Chen (陳) and four Indonesian nationals -- were questioned.
Fishing boat Man Jui Fu 6 is seized into the custody of coast guards. CNA photo Nov. 4, 2026
Prosecutors said the five crew members, along with the boat's owner, surnamed Lee (李), and captain, surnamed Huang (黃), were scheduled to undergo further questioning over their suspected involvement in the case involving Chang Chun-chieh (張俊傑), a former legislative office director for independent lawmaker Kao Chin Su-mei's (高金素梅).
Chang was allegedly seen first boarding a fishing boat called Chien Chun 168 (錢春168號) at Zhengbin Fishing Port in Keelung on the night of Oct. 28 before being picked up at sea by the Man Jui Fu 6, they said.
Chang Chun-chieh (left), a former legislative office director for independent lawmaker Kao Chin Su-mei, is escorted by an investigator. CNA file photo
Chang was among 24 people indicted by the Taipei District Prosecutors Office in June on charges of conspiring with Kao Chin to misappropriate public assistant fees, in violation of the Anti-Corruption Act.
He had been on the run for nearly two months after breaking his electronic monitoring wristband at Daan Forest Park in Taipei on Sept. 6 while out on NT$10 million (US$304,634) bail, prompting the Taipei District Court to issue a warrant for his arrest.
According to the Taiwan High Prosecutors Office, the former aide to Kao Chin is also under investigation in a separate case over allegations that he received funds from China to establish spy networks in Taiwan, in violation of the National Security Act.

content:
中国承诺支持香港的贸易角色和加入RCEP |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 5 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
中国承诺支持香港的贸易角色和加入RCEP
商务部部长王文涛表示，北京将帮助香港加入RCEP、升级CEPA，并打造金融、航运和科技创新服务业，加强香港作为全球贸易枢纽的地位。
中国商务部部长王文涛11月5日表示，北京支持香港在国际贸易中发挥更大作用，并尽快加入区域全面经济伙伴关系协定（RCEP）。
王毅在第九届虹桥国际经济论坛香港分论坛上发表视频致辞时表示，商务部将积极支持香港作为内地与世界门户的独特地位，帮助香港巩固竞争优势，更好地融入国家发展。他补充说，支持将有助于将香港的第一个五年计划愿景变为现实。
王表示，商务部将帮助香港利用高度开放、广泛的国际联系和先进的专业服务，打造高附加值的供应链服务中心。深化国际法律与争议解决服务中心、区域知识产权交易中心建设，打造数字贸易、绿色贸易、离岸贸易等新业态示范渠道。
该部长表示，他正在与香港政府合作进行新一轮CE​​PA升级。重点是服务业，特别是金融、航运和科技创新，进一步向香港开放，并探索更多境内自由化措施。升级还将促进互联互通，支持大湾区先行先试，促进生产要素高效流动，并对接内地与香港的规则、法规和管理标准。
王毅表示，北京将支持香港在国际经济合作中发挥更大作用，尽快签署对外贸易协定、加入RCEP，丰富区域制度安排。他表示，商务部将支持香港发挥超级联系人、超级增值作用，深度参与高质量“一带一路”合作，为国家连接全球市场、扩大开放合作、参与全球治理搭建桥梁。
