zh_title: 美光耗资 45 亿美元的桃园工厂建设因劳资纠纷而暂停
summary: 美光科技已暂停桃园 Fab 11E 工厂的建设，因为该公司与桃园工会未能就更明确的利润分享条款达成一致。彭博社报道称，除了小型安全工作外，该工地的活动几乎已停止，一些消息人士称，高管们担心与工人谈判的不确定性。该公司尚未就此举发表声明，但已将暂停通知当地官员。 “台湾在美光的全球足迹中发挥着重要作用，我们今天的业务仍在继续
content:
美光科技已暂停桃园 Fab 11E 工厂的建设，因为该公司与桃园工会未能就更明确的利润分享条款达成一致。彭博社报道称，除了小型安全工作外，该工地的活动几乎已停止，一些消息人士称，高管们担心与工人谈判的不确定性。该公司尚未就此举发表声明，但已将暂停通知当地官员。美光表示：“台湾在美光的全球足迹中发挥着重要作用，我们今天的运营继续正常进行。” “我们有信心为客户保持业务连续性。”该公司最近宣布了一项奖金，可为一些符合条件的工人提供高达年薪五倍的奖金，并且还与规模更大的台中工会达成协议，尽管一些成员表示他们对结果不满意。另一方面，桃园工会仍在坚持争取更好的条件，两党定于11月6日再次会面。上个月，桃园工会甚至发起了一日罢工，以表明芯片制造商的决心，以及如果不满足他们的要求，其运营将如何受到干扰。三大存储芯片制造商——美光、三星和SK海力士——的工人最近一直在抗议，要求从这些公司目前从人工智能存储芯片热潮中获得的巨额利润中分得更大的份额。
SK海力士最近同意向员工每人支付5万美元，今年每位员工将获得47.7万美元的奖金，明年最高可达90万美元。三星代工厂的工人也争取平均34万美元的奖金，该奖金在最后一刻获得批准，避免了可能扰乱公司运营的大规模罢工。这些韩国公司的员工期望获得高达 40 万美元的绩效奖金，并且拒绝接受令人垂涎的海外培训计划，转而青睐冷酷的现金。虽然该公司尚未就桃园工厂的停工发表声明，但很难相信在距离下次桃园工会会议如此之近的时间采取这一举措是巧合。值得注意的是，美光还在世界各地开发其他工厂，计划在日本建设 HBM 晶圆厂，计划在新加坡建设耗资 240 亿美元的项目，以及美国各地的工厂。不过，该公司表示期待与工人们达成协议，台湾政府希望双方能获得双赢的结果。

【原文 English Original】
Micron has paused construction on its Fab 11E site at Taoyuan as the company and its Taoyuan labor union have failed to reach an agreement regarding clearer profit-sharing terms. Bloomberg reports that activity on the site has all but halted, except for minor safety work, with some sources saying that executives are concerned about uncertainties regarding negotiations with its workers. The company hasn’t released a statement about the move but has already informed local officials about the suspension. “Taiwan plays an important role in Micron’s global footprint, and our operations today continue as normal,” Micron said. “We are confident in maintaining business continuity for our customers.” The company has recently announced a bonus that could give as much as five times the annual salary of some eligible workers, and has also wrapped up a deal with the bigger Taichung union, although some members say they were dissatisfied with the outcome. On the other hand, the Taoyuan union is still holding out for better terms, with the two parties set to meet again on November 6. It even launched a one-day strike last month to show the chipmaker its resolve and how its operations could be disrupted if it does not meet their demands. Workers from the big three memory chip manufacturers — Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix — have been protesting recently and demanding a bigger slice of the massive profits that these companies are currently making from the AI memory chip boom. SK hynix has recently agreed to pay staff $50,00 apiece , with each employee set to receive $477,000 in bonuses this year and up to $900,000 next year. Samsung Foundry workers also fought for a $340,000 average bonus , which received approval at the last minute and averted a massive strike that would have disrupted the company’s operations. Employees from these South Korean companies expect to nab performance bonuses of up to $400,000 and are rejecting coveted overseas training programs in favor of cold, hard cash. While the company hasn’t made a statement regarding the suspension of work on its Taoyuan site, it’s hard to believe that the move happening so close to its next meeting with the Taoyuan union is a coincidence. It should be noted that Micron is also developing other sites across the world, with plans for an HBM fab in Japan , a $24-billion development on the way in Singapore , plus facilities across the U.S. Nevertheless, the company says it is looking forward to reaching an agreement with the workers, with the Taiwan government hoping for a win-win outcome for both parties.

ElevenLabs now lets users publish AI-generated music directly on SoundCloud
7:00 AM PST · November 5, 2026
Audio AI company ElevenLabs on Thursday said users will be able to publish AI-generated music created using its ElevenMusic platform directly on SoundCloud.
ElevenLabs is also offering SoundCloud Artist Pro users three months of ElevenMusic Pro, which lets you generate up to 1,000 songs, split songs’ stem files 500 times, and five custom styles or vocals per month.
The company first released a music-generation model in 2025, and followed it up with a consumer app that lets you generate songs using prompts in April 2026. Then a month later, it released a new music model that could switch genres mid-track and handle more complex vocals. ElevenLabs said that users have so far created over 25 million tracks using its models.
SoundCloud has also been giving AI tools to artists, though it’s taking a different approach. Last month, it partnered with AI music tooling company Moises to let artists export and import songs to and from SoundCloud. The company also has integrations with other platforms like Google Flow Music and the music remix platform, Hook.
“SoundCloud has always been a place where artists experiment, push boundaries, and turn creative ideas into something bigger. By becoming the first platform to bring ElevenMusic creations directly to fans beyond its own ecosystem, we’re opening up new possibilities for artists to experiment, share their work, and build an audience,” SoundCloud CEO Eliah Seton said in a statement.
ElevenLabs also has a partnership with Spotify in which authors can use its audio models to generate narrations for their audiobooks and publish them on the music streaming service. While Spotify has signed partnerships with labels for products that let people use AI for remixing tracks, it has not yet announced any model partners like ElevenLabs.
Overall, though, music streaming platforms today seem more inclined towards labeling and helping users filter out AI generated music, especially as the tech slowly grows popular with musicians. Deezer, for example, is introducing a toggle that lets you filter out AI music completely, while Bandcamp has put a blanket ban on AI-generated tracks. Spotify and YouTube have taken a more cautious approach to labeling tracks.

content:
韩联社首尔11月5日电 韩国前总统尹锡悦带头发动内乱案二审将于明年1月底宣判。
首尔高等法院刑事审判第12-1庭当天就上述案件进行二审庭审，决定将于明年1月26日下午2时30分许作出宣判。这将是该案一审于今年2月19日宣判后，二审法院时隔近一年作出宣判。
负责调查尹锡悦等人内乱叛国案的独立检察组（独检组）曾建议法院对尹锡悦判处死刑，并分别判处前国防部长官金龙显、前国军情报司令卢相元（音）无期徒刑和有期徒刑30年。
资料图片：左起依次为尹锡悦、金龙显、前国军反间谍司令吕寅兄、前无人机作战司令金容大。 韩联社/联合摄影记者团、宪法裁判所供图（图片严禁转载复制）
尹锡悦在法庭上发表最后陈述时再次主张，实施紧急戒严旨在向国民告知在野党单方面削减国家预算、单方面通过立法，以及针对政府官员频繁发起弹劾等，不构成内乱罪。他还主张，紧急戒严未造成国会、选举管理委员会等宪法机构职能瘫痪，军警也未对市民、国会议员和公务员施加暴力，总统行使宪法赋予的权限不属于内乱罪。
尹锡悦强烈否认独检组所谓“为独揽大权而宣布实施紧急戒严”的指控，并再次主张，如果其未被弹劾，宪政秩序和国家政务本应得以恢复正常‌。他还批评现政府和执政党，称现代文明国家经过长期发展所建立的司法体系正在崩塌，让人觉得国家确实正处于危机之中。
资料图片：2024年12月3日晚，在首尔龙山总统府，韩国总统尹锡悦面向全民发表谈话，宣布实施紧急戒严。 韩联社/总统办公室供图（图片严禁转载复制）
尹锡悦等人因通过“12·3”紧急戒严发动旨在扰乱国家宪政秩序的暴乱而于去年在羁押状态下被起诉。今年2月，一审法院认定，尹锡悦派遣军队封锁国会之举构成《刑法》规定的内乱罪，判处其无期徒刑。（完）

中新社台北11月5日电 交易商表示，由于对人工智能(AI)数据中心部署延迟的担忧引发科技股大幅抛售，台湾股市周四延续近期跌势，基准股指暴跌1,374.19点，跌幅3.2%，收于42,000点大关下方。
台湾证券交易所基准指数收报41,574.72点，为7月31日以来的最低水平，盘中一度下跌1,435.34点，盘中低点41,513.57点。营业额总计 9,260.2 亿元新台币（282.1 亿美元）。
跌幅达1,374.19点，为台湾股市历史上第13大单日收盘跌幅。
由于担心美国人工智能数据中心部署可能被推迟，费城半导体指数隔夜大幅下跌，引发科技巨头、冷却解决方案提供商和印刷电路板 (PCB) 制造商的广泛抛售，投资者情绪减弱。
在权重股中，台积电(TSMC)在盘中早些时候帮助缓冲了大盘，但在下午的交易中面临更大的抛售压力。收盘跌0.88%，报2,240新台币。
其他主要科技股跌幅更大，联发科跌 6.86%，至新台币 3,460 元；台达电子跌 7.38%，至新台币 1,130 元；鸿海精密工业股份有限公司（俗称富士康）跌 2.08%，至新台币 235 元。
冷却解决方案供应商奥拉斯科技、晶德精密和高力热处理均涨停10%，收盘价分别为新台币1,170元、新台币5,805元和新台币1,290元。 AVC Corp.下跌9.04%，至新台币2,565元。
PCB板块中，精力材料、台联科技、联兴科技、文泰国际、金路电子等均收跌10%涨停板。三大ABF基板制造商——欣兴科技、南亚电路板和景硕科技——也以涨停收盘。
在传统行业中，只有金融、纺织、水泥和橡胶股在大范围抛售中表现出相对弹性。
台新证券投资咨询首席策略官黄文清表示，美国科技股和半导体股疲软，加上美国中期选举后的不确定性，加剧了台湾市场的波动。
黄说，虽然人工智能数据中心的部署可能会被推迟，但对相关组件的需求仍然完好。他补充说，投资者应继续关注人工智能数据中心部署的步伐以及美伊谈判的进展。
黄说，鉴于台积电基本面稳健且跌幅相对温和，随着行业轮动的继续，台交所短期内可能会在 40,000 至 42,000 点之间波动。
与此同时，台湾证券交易所的数据显示，外国机构投资者在主板净抛售价值新台币 1,024.6 亿美元的股票，这是有记录以来第十大单日净抛售量。

Taiwan stocks sink 3.2% on AI data center concerns
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 5 (CNA) Taiwan shares extended their recent losing streak Thursday, with the benchmark Taiex plunging 1,374.19 points, or 3.2 percent, to close below the 42,000-point mark as concerns over delays in artificial intelligence (AI) data center deployment sparked heavy selling in technology stocks, dealers said.
The Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, closed at 41,574.72, its lowest level since July 31, after falling as much as 1,435.34 points during the session to an intraday low of 41,513.57. Turnover totaled NT$926.02 billion (US$28.21 billion).
The 1,374.19-point decline was the 13th largest single-day closing-point loss in the history of Taiwan's stock market.
Investor sentiment weakened after the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index posted steep losses overnight on concerns that AI data center deployment in the United States could be delayed, triggering broad selling in technology heavyweights, cooling-solution providers and printed circuit board (PCB) makers.
Among heavyweight stocks, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), which had helped cushion the broader market earlier in the session, came under heavier selling pressure in afternoon trading. It closed down 0.88 percent at NT$2,240.
Other major technology stocks posted steeper declines, with MediaTek Inc. falling 6.86 percent to NT$3,460, Delta Electronics Inc. dropping 7.38 percent to NT$1,130, and Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., better known as Foxconn, losing 2.08 percent to NT$235.
Cooling-solution providers Auras Technology Co., Jentech Precision Industrial Co. and Kaori Heat Treatment Co. all hit the 10 percent daily limit, closing at NT$1,170, NT$5,805 and NT$1,290, respectively. AVC Corp. fell 9.04 percent to NT$2,565.
In the PCB sector, Elite Material Co., Taiwan Union Technology Corp., ITEQ Corp., Ventec International Group and Gold Circuit Electronics all closed down the 10 percent daily limit. The three major ABF substrate makers -- Unimicron Technology Corp., Nan Ya PCB Corp. and Kinsus Interconnect Technology Corp. -- also ended the day at their daily limit.
Among traditional industries, only financial, textile, cement and rubber stocks showed relative resilience against the broader sell-off.
Tony Huang (黃文清), chief strategy officer at Taishin Securities Investment Advisory, said weakness in U.S. technology and semiconductor stocks, coupled with uncertainty following the U.S. midterm elections, had added to volatility in Taiwan's market.
While AI data center deployment could be delayed, demand for related components remains intact, Huang said. Investors should continue to monitor the pace of AI data center deployment as well as developments in U.S.-Iran negotiations, he added.
Given TSMC's solid fundamentals and relatively modest decline, the Taiex is likely to fluctuate between 40,000 and 42,000 points in the near term as sector rotation continues, Huang said.
Meanwhile, foreign institutional investors sold a net NT$102.46 billion worth of shares on the main board, the 10th largest one-day net sell-off on record, according to the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

The Lantos Foundation for Tom Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice
The Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice stands with the people of Hong Kong on the front lines of the fight for freedom & democracy.
Courageous Hong Kong democracy activists have been protesting for months against a dangerous Chinese extradition bill that would have undermined their independence and freedom. Though the bill has now been formally withdrawn, the fight is not over. Since June, thousands of protesters have been attacked and injured by police and mainland gangs and over 1,100 people have been detained. Those arrested for peacefully protesting have been charged with offenses that could put them in jail for many years.
Hong Kong Democracy protesters have won the first huge victory in the court of public opinion, but the next victories will need to be won in the courts of law.
Just a few months ago, the Lantos Foundation was proud to give our highest award to the most recognizable leader of the democracy movement – Joshua Wong. While such leadership is important, all of the brave democracy crusaders deserve more than our admiration. We must equip them to defend themselves against the crushing apparatus of the Chinese communist state. This legal defense fund aims to support Joshua and his compatriots as they defend themselves against false accusations that could land them in prison for years to come.
Our hope is that we can match their courage and determination in the form of financial support that will ensure they have fair representation. It is critical that the rule of law be upheld at this pivotal moment in Hong Kong's history. The eyes of the world may be on Hong Kong, but the eyes of history will be on those of us enjoying our own freedom and democracy - let us match our words and good wishes with the resources to defend those on the front lines of this fight for freedom.
These legal defense funds will be officially disbursed through the Lantos Foundation's Front Line Fund grant program.

Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
7:19 AM PST · November 5, 2026
Dropbox is making a big push into AI infrastructure with a $350 million acquisition of cloud technology company Tigris Data, marking what appears to be its largest acquisition to date.
Announced Thursday, the deal is expected to strengthen Dropbox’s AI infrastructure capabilities and support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at businesses and developers building AI models and agents.
Dropbox told TechCrunch via email that the transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. The company also said it currently has no plans to reduce headcount as part of the acquisition. The company already cut 9% of its global workforce last month, WSJ reported.
DBX Agent Cloud will initially offer object storage as a standalone product, allowing businesses to purchase storage independently and use it with existing tools and applications built for Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service), which is a cloud storage service that enables businesses to store and retrieve large volumes of data.
Beyond its infrastructure ambitions, Dropbox is also bringing more AI capabilities to its core product. Users will be able to ask AI to perform supported tasks using their files, choose between different AI models, and connect their Dropbox content to third-party tools, including ChatGPT, Claude and Muse.
The company also plans to expand DBX Agent Cloud with additional capabilities designed to help AI systems work with different types of content, including documents, images, audio and video. Other planned additions include filesystem features that will allow AI agents to manage files and maintain continuity across tasks and sessions.
Dropbox says the updated experience has already reached more than 70,000 teams. The initial rollout is available to eligible Standard and Advanced customers in the U.S., U.K., and Australia, with broader availability planned for 2027.
Tigris Data was founded by former Uber engineers who helped develop the ride-hailing company’s storage infrastructure. The company provides cloud storage technology that helps businesses store and access data across different regions. Its platform automatically positions data closer to the users and computing resources that need it, helping reduce access times and improve performance.
Tigris Data raised $25 million in a Series A funding round last year.
While the Tigris deal appears to be Dropbox’s largest acquisition, it is not the company’s first move to expand its AI capabilities through M&A. Dropbox has previously acquired several AI-focused companies, including Reclaim.ai, Promoted.ai, and Mobius Labs.

广告

（德国之声中文网）路透社引述两位知情人士的消息称，约60万块英伟达先进[人工智能](https://www.dw.com/zh/%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD/t-69572979)芯片目前存放在香港，等待运往中国内地。尽管中国科技企业存在需求，但北京方面尚未批准这些芯片的大规模进口。

这批H200芯片的库存规模此前未被报道过。它反映出北京不愿进一步加深对美国技术的依赖的同时，中国企业又需要英伟达先进算力，以满足全球第二大经济体对人工智能激增的需求。

三位知情人士表示，近几个月来，中国已允许其中部分芯片进入境内。

其中一位知情人士称，过去几个月里，几家中国大型互联网企业各自获得了约1万枚H200芯片。

知情人士表示，已有少量芯片通过中间商和间接渠道运抵中国，但未明确具体数量。

不过，这些知情人士指出，[北京方面尚未批准向中国内地进行大规模进口](https://www.dw.com/zh/%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%E4%BA%BA%E5%A3%AB%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E6%B5%B7%E5%85%B3%E4%B8%8D%E5%85%81%E8%AE%B8%E8%8B%B1%E4%BC%9F%E8%BE%BEh200%E8%8A%AF%E7%89%87%E5%85%A5%E5%A2%83/a-75503113)。

中国工业和信息化部以及国家发改委未回应置评请求。英伟达以及中国的科技公司阿里巴巴、字节跳动、深度求索（DeepSeek）和[腾讯](https://www.dw.com/zh/%E5%AD%97%E8%8A%82%E9%98%BF%E9%87%8C%E8%85%BE%E8%AE%AF%E7%A0%B8%E6%95%B0%E7%99%BE%E4%BA%BF%E7%BE%8E%E9%87%91-%E6%8A%A2%E8%B4%AD%E8%8B%B1%E4%BC%9F%E8%BE%BE%E8%8A%AF%E7%89%87/a-79712724)也均未作出回应。.

更多阅读：[黄仁勋：中国终将开放AI芯片市场](https://www.dw.com/zh/%E9%BB%84%E4%BB%81%E5%8B%8B%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E7%BB%88%E5%B0%86%E5%BC%80%E6%94%BEai%E8%8A%AF%E7%89%87%E5%B8%82%E5%9C%BA/a-77207319)

## H200并非最先进，但极具实用价值

H200虽然不是英伟达最新的AI处理器，但其性能仍是中国替代产品尚未达到的，在训练AI模型时非常有用——尤其是在结合英伟达的软件使用时。

自2022年以来，美国出口管制一直试图限制中国获取先进英伟达芯片以及制造这些芯片所需设备。

由于授权供应受限，中国买家转而寻求中间商或通过间接渠道采购，这推高了非官方市场上的价格。

据一位知情人士透露，截至10月底，在中国大陆，一台搭载8张H200芯片的服务器售价超过600万元人民币（约合90万美元），约为一年前价格的三倍。该知情人士补充称，搭载英伟达更新一代Blackwell芯片（同样受到美国出口管制）的服务器，单台售价则超过了2000万元人民币。

## 贸易与技术领域的紧张局势

H200芯片正处于华盛顿与北京之间更广泛的贸易与技术紧张局势之中。

美国曾一度禁止向中国出口H200芯片。去年，[特朗普政府允许英伟达向获批的中国客户出售该芯片](https://www.dw.com/zh/%E7%BE%8E%E5%95%86%E5%8A%A1%E9%83%A8%E5%AE%98%E5%91%98%E8%8B%B1%E4%BC%9F%E8%BE%BE%E5%90%91%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E5%87%BA%E5%8F%A3%E6%9E%81%E5%B0%91%E9%87%8Fh200%E8%8A%AF%E7%89%87/a-77965889)。这一政策转变发生在中美贸易谈判之后。

与此同时，北京方面也针对H200的进口实施了限制，这反映出中国对于过度依赖美国技术的担忧。

科技媒体《The Information》在7月份报道称，中国相关部门已告知包括阿里巴巴、字节跳动和深度求索（DeepSeek）在内的企业，它们或许能获准购买数量有限的H200芯片，用于训练AI模型。据报道，获批芯片的总量可能不到20万块。此外，北京方面希望企业在推理环节优先使用中国国产处理器。推理是指运行人工智能模型的任务。

路透社上个月报道称，字节跳动、阿里巴巴和腾讯订购了超过300万张英伟达RTX Pro 5500显卡。这是一款性能较弱、符合出口合规要求的产品，其总标价超过350亿美元。

ONSITE Friendsgiving Potluck Feast at bliss, Tue, Nov 10, 2026, 12:00 PM | Meetup
ONSITE Friendsgiving Potluck Feast at bliss
Hosted by Tish V. and 2 others
Tish V. is a Super Organizer
12:00 - 1:30 pm (EST), Tuesday November 10th at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd in Mt. Pleasant. COME ONE, COME ALL bearing a heart full of gratitude and your favorite dish to add to the Friendsgiving Potluck Feast.
Please look at the Friendsgiving Menu and text which dish you plan to contribute for our feast to Midge Moran at (843) 906-0059.
Turkey & Dressing (Tish Voit), Gravy, Rolls & Butter, Cranberry Sauce, Sweet Potato Casserole (Marsha Blyth), Green Bean Casserole, Mashed Potatoes, Roasted Carrots (Cara Woschenko), Fall Salads (Sue Dock-Chickpea) Karen Williford (Mixed Greens Salad w/ Pecans, Pomegranate, Feta and Lemon Honey Vinaigrette) (Robyn Meara-Salad), Deviled Eggs, Pumpkin & Pecan Pies (Di Johnson), Vanilla Ice Cream (Katherine Walters) & Whipped Cream
EAT, reunite with bliss Buddies, EAT some more, treat yourself to a Guided Consciousness Meditation w/ Dr Diane Hamrick and/or Brain Tap Meditation w/ Dr Antoinette Biegaj, then take your empty dish and happy belly home to NAP.
Let's relax. Plenty of indoor and outdoor seating, turkey & dressing, drinks, plates, napkins, glasses and cutlery will be provided.
Let's take care of each other. Especially now with the holidays upon us, please stay home if you are feeling ill yourself or if you have been directly exposed to others with any contagious ailments that no one wants to share with you.
Let's have fun together. Many hands make light work. Please pitch in to help with set up, serving and/or clean up.
Let's open our hearts in thanksgiving. In this season of celebration of gratitude, please consider making an end of the year donation of your choosing to support all that has become bliss for so many.
